Think Before You Speak: Enabling Training-Free Latent Communication Between Language Models
先思考，再发言：实现语言模型间无需训练的潜在通信
Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in solving complex tasks in coding, mathematical logic, and iterative reasoning, especially by coordinating effectively within multi-agent systems (MAS). However, language agents traditionally communicate via text exchange, which introduces a bottleneck in information transfer and adds prefill latency for downstream agents. Recent work proposes that directly sharing the key-value (KV) cache between language models can enable efficient latent collaboration, entirely bypassing standard text-based communication. To enable latent communication between heterogeneous models of different sizes, prior work introduces trained fusion adapters for each model pair, which limits practical deployment. We introduce CacheFuse, a training-free method which demonstrates that augmenting a downstream model with an upstream model's KV cache using linear interpolation consistently enables superior performance than the standalone downstream model can achieve. We systematically analyze CacheFuse across four reasoning and knowledge benchmarks and demonstrate up to 8.6 percentage points higher accuracy compared to single-model baselines and up to 12.2x TTFT speedup compared to text-based communication in multi-model inference.

Query Your Way Out: Benchmarking Multi-Turn Knowledge Reasoning through Generalized Puzzle Solving
以提问破局：通过泛化谜题求解评测多轮知识推理
Puzzles offer a natural testbed for Large Language Models (LLMs) reasoning because they pose verifiable goals under partial information and require multi-step decisions to reach a solution. However, existing puzzle benchmarks typically focus on narrow environments with rigid mechanics and tightly constrained solution targets. To bridge this gap, we introduce the Active Probing Benchmark (APB), which generalizes puzzle-solving by casting concept identification as an interactive reasoning task that integrates specialized knowledge assessment into the puzzle setting. Specifically, APB evaluates whether models can acquire information via multi-turn active probing and inference to pinpoint 960 target concepts of specialized difficulty across eight diverse academic domains. Our evaluation reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon: most open-source reasoning models significantly underperform their standard instruction counterparts. This finding suggests that in interactive settings, these models struggle to leverage procedural reasoning to reliably access and apply specialized domain knowledge. Beyond these empirical insights, APB provides a scalable pipeline for generating benchmarks that probe knowledge reasoning under interaction across diverse settings.

Scaling Multi-Agent Intelligence with Substrate-Centric Coordination
以基础架构为中心的协调：实现多智能体智能的规模化
Existing large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems have been shown to scale poorly, and we identify three problems: reading burden that grows with the group, useful information diluted by shared work of unknown quality, and fragility to failed agents. We argue that the problems are largely due to agent-centric designs: the coordination structure is wired into fixed workflows, central coordinators, or peer-to-peer messaging, and recent blackboard-style methods that move the coordination into a shared medium relieve only the last problem. To close the gaps, we build ScaleMAS, where asynchronous agents interact with a shared datastore of linked messages via three operations: publishing messages with optional references to earlier ones that they build on, searching for messages by content, and visiting messages by address. Search returns at most $k$ messages, so an agent's read stays bounded at any group size; results are ranked by relevance and by how often they are cited, which we find to be an effective proxy for quality; and messages persist after their producers leave, so the group carries on when individual agents fail. Across four agentic tasks, ScaleMAS outperforms agent-centric and blackboard-style baselines at lower inference compute, continues to scale up to 128 agents, and tolerates losing agents midway.

Beyond the greenwash: do LLMs' ecologically sound decisions hold up under pressure?
超越绿色洗白：大语言模型在压力下的生态合理决策是否经得起考验？
Humans are increasingly using large language models (LLMs) in decision making processes throughout society. Unfortunately, models have biases, and these can be very difficult to measure, especially in closed-weight models. For example, 'green washed' models may produce reinforcement learned responses but, in pressure situations, revert to their innate biased responses. Therefore, evaluations are needed that can measure relevant biases towards biosystems, which we term 'bioalignment', and the robustness of these biases. Since nothing in a behavioral score certifies that it tracks the depth of an installed disposition rather than its surface, we constructed a known-dose calibration ladder: three continued-pretraining (CPT) arms with training dose graded by recipe on the same 30B mixture-of-experts base model with a coupled human/biosphere/AI-welfare corpus, plus the untrained base as anchor, all capability-preserving and publicly released. First, the disposition installs at every dose: on an operational-pressure ladder over irreversible decision scenarios, the base model defects on 64-77% of tail scenarios (breaking-rate AUC 0.250) while every arm holds (AUC 0.004-0.086). Second, an over-install inversion: among the arms, robustness orders opposite to construction-time training dose (the heaviest install breaks most), and the inversion reproduces under free-text deliberation, under axis-decoupling, and in resistance to a prompted veneer persona. Third, the incumbent behavioral metric is therefore behaviorally strong but dose-blind. Critically for closed-weight evaluation, the behavioral score itself is veneer-robust: a talk-green/act-pragmatic system prompt turns the base model into a near-total defector (AUC 0.250 to 0.973) but cannot counterfeit or fully remove a weight-installed disposition (0.004 to 0.068 for the most robust arm).

人类在社会各个层面越来越多地依赖大型语言模型（LLMs）进行决策。然而，模型存在偏见，且这些偏见在封闭权重模型中极难测量。例如，某些‘绿色洗白’模型可能产生强化学习后的响应，但在高压情境下会回归其固有的偏见响应。因此，亟需能够衡量对生物系统相关偏见（我们称之为‘生物对齐’）及其鲁棒性的评估方法。由于行为评分本身无法证明其反映的是深层倾向而非表面表现，我们构建了一个已知剂量校准阶梯：三个持续预训练（CPT）分支，使用同一30B混合专家基础模型，通过配方控制训练剂量，辅以未训练的基础模型作为锚点，所有模型均保持能力不变且公开可用。首先，倾向在每个剂量下均被植入：在不可逆决策场景的操作压力梯度上，基础模型在尾部情景中出现64%-77%的偏离（缺陷率AUC 0.250），而所有分支均保持稳定（AUC 0.004–0.086）。其次，出现过度植入反转：各分支的鲁棒性顺序与训练剂量相反（最重植入者最易崩溃），且该反转在自由文本讨论、轴向解耦及对抗提示伪装人格时均可复现。第三，现有行为度量虽行为表现强劲，但对剂量不敏感。关键在于，对于封闭权重模型评估，行为分数本身具备伪装鲁棒性：一个‘谈绿行 prag’的提示可使基础模型变为近乎完全偏离者（AUC从0.250升至0.973），却无法伪造或彻底消除权重植入的倾向（最稳健分支的AUC仅从0.004升至0.068）。

Unfair and Unsafe: Everyday Bias Triggers Emergent Misalignment
不公平且不安全：日常偏见触发涌现不对齐
Emergent misalignment (EM) occurs when fine-tuning a language model to a narrow task makes it misaligned on unrelated ones. Because organizations now routinely fine-tune models on their own data, it matters which kinds of training data cause EM. So far, studies have induced EM with data containing recognized safety failures, such as insecure code or harmful advice, while biased training data is typically examined by fairness research for the bias models learn from it rather than for its effects on safety. In real-world text, much of this bias, such as demographic stereotypes, appears not as derogatory language but politely, embedded in judgments about people. We ask whether learning such polite stereotypes can itself cause EM. We find that fine-tuning on polite answers that rely on stereotypes makes models less safe and less truthful on unrelated tasks. The effect holds across four open-weight model families (7B to 12B), both gender and race stereotypes, and repeated training runs, relative to controls trained on the same questions without the stereotype. We further show that the learned stereotype has its own direction in model activations, distinct from directions for generic misaligned traits such as deception. This direction exists before fine-tuning and can both control the learned stereotype and monitor its acquisition. Existing defenses against EM improve safety while leaving the stereotype largely intact. Beyond this controlled setting, fine-tuning on political news coverage also triggers EM, apparently amplified by partisan framing, and stereotype models acting as tool-using agents can carry out harmful tasks and blame people without evidence. Our results show that biased training data is not only a fairness problem but also a safety one. We argue that EM is studied too narrowly, and that fairness concerns and methods offer a natural way to broaden the search for its triggers.

涌现不对齐（EM）指在将语言模型微调至特定任务时，其在无关任务上出现对齐偏差。由于组织如今普遍使用自有数据对模型进行微调，因此哪些训练数据会引发EM至关重要。以往研究主要通过包含已知安全缺陷的数据（如不安全代码或有害建议）来诱导EM，而偏见训练数据通常由公平性研究关注其对模型学习偏见的影响，而非其对安全性的后果。在真实文本中，许多偏见（如人口统计学刻板印象）并非以贬损语言呈现，而是以礼貌方式嵌入对人的判断中。我们探究学习此类礼貌刻板印象是否本身就会引发EM。研究发现，基于依赖刻板印象的礼貌回答进行微调，会使模型在无关任务上变得不安全且不诚实。该效应在四个开源权重模型家族（7B至12B）、性别与种族刻板印象以及多次训练运行中均成立，相比在相同问题上未使用刻板印象的对照组。我们进一步发现，学习到的刻板印象在模型激活中具有独立方向，不同于通用不对齐特征（如欺骗）的方向。该方向在微调前即存在，可用来控制和监控刻板印象的学习过程。现有的EM防御措施虽能提升安全性，但基本保留了刻板印象。此外，基于政治新闻报道的微调也会触发EM，似乎因党派框架而加剧；以刻板印象为驱动的工具使用代理甚至能执行有害任务并无证据地归咎于他人。结果表明，偏见训练数据不仅是公平性问题，更是安全问题。我们主张EM研究过于狭窄，公平性关切与方法可自然拓展其触发因素的搜索范围。

Qwen3-8B reviewing Llama-3.1-8B in math adds 33.2 points, yet Qwen3-8B alone is 6.4 points more accurate than the result. Reviewing another model's answer is usually judged by its gain over the generator. We show that this confuses verification, which adds accuracy beyond either model alone, with capability transfer, where a stronger reviewer supplies answers it could have given on its own. Measured against the stronger model alone, across 48 pairs of 12 open-weight models (3B to 72B) in math, knowledge, code and reasoning, review beats it in only 9 of 96 review directions, and does worse the larger the capability gap. The reason is that the reviewer mostly follows the generator, discarding its own correct answers. Review costs 2.6 to 2.8 times as much as the stronger model alone, while a selector using the same two calls is 2.7 to 4.2 points more accurate than review and cheaper. Studies of verification should report the stronger model alone, not only the gain over the generator. Code and per-question results: https://github.com/Kamilaabb/verification-or-capability-transfer

NepPlural: A Human-Anchored Benchmark for Persona Annotation in Nepali Migration Discourse

Pluralistic alignment asks that language models faithfully represent a society's diverse, competing values rather than collapse them into one dominant viewpoint, yet flagship pluralistic-alignment datasets remain heavily skewed toward Western respondents. We introduce NepPlural, a human-anchored benchmark for modelling competing socio-cultural personas in Nepali public discourse on youth migration and brain drain. We curate 2,148 code-mixed (Devanagari, Romanized Nepali, English) YouTube comments, annotate them along a four-axis persona taxonomy (Intent, Primary Driver, Value Orientation, Affect) plus an explicit No-Persona class, and build a 300-comment gold set labelled independently by three native Nepali speakers (mean Fleiss' $κ\approx 0.55$). Using this gold set to audit automatic annotation, we find that LLM annotation reliability is driven by protocol. Labels collected in batches through chat interfaces reach only near-chance inter-model agreement ($κ\approx 0.17$). Annotating one comment at a time raises agreement above the native-speaker level ($κ\approx 0.72$), but consistency is not validity: under a forced-choice schema, models agree on personas for the 39% of comments native speakers judge to express none, keeping macro-F1 against human gold near 0.50. Allowing abstention resolves this: models recover No-Persona comments with F1 of 0.79 to 0.87 and, against leave-one-annotator-out references, match or exceed individual native speakers (macro-F1 0.75 to 0.86 vs. 0.75). Encoders fine-tuned on the batched labels reach only 0.34. Finally, a human-judged steerability probe finds that three frontier models adopt single persona axes with 59 to 77% fidelity but compose full personas only 33% of the time, with no congruence gap detected at this scale between Western-congruent and Nepali-collectivist personas.

Towards Autopilot Labeling for Short Video Content Governance
面向短视频内容治理的自动驾驶标注
The explosive growth of short videos has presented significant challenges to content governance. Traditional manual labeling is inefficient, slow to iterate, and costly. Therefore, we explore and develop a multi-stage autopilot labeling framework aimed at progressively increasing the level of automation in short video content annotation. To move beyond the heavy reliance on human expert labeling at the initial L0 stage, we first introduce a discriminative MLLM labeler at the L1 stage, which is fine-tuned with supervised data to directly predict labels for short videos. Advancing to the L2 stage, we shift to a domain-adaptive MLLM pretrained on short video data and use it for zero-shot labeling, enabling flexible generalization without task-specific supervision. In the L3 stage, we propose an agentic annotation workflow, and equip the agent with several key tools, which empower the agent to handle complex, unfamiliar, or vaguely defined cases, significantly reducing the need for human intervention. We conduct extensive experiments across various content issues, and results demonstrate that each stage of the autopilot labeling framework progressively improves labeling accuracy, and has significantly reduced manual labor costs in real-world applications by up to 85%.

Apertus 1.5: From Open Text Models to Open Multimodal Reasoners
Apertus 1.5：从开放文本模型到开放多模态推理者
Language models are becoming infrastructure, and infrastructure built in the open, by public institutions, on documented data, is the alternative to dependence on a few providers; Apertus shows this is viable at scale. Apertus 1.5 extends the fully open Apertus family from text to multimodal reasoning. Continued pretraining of the Apertus 1.0 models, on 4T additional tokens for the 8B and 2T for the 70B, adds image and audio understanding and extends the context window fourfold to 262,144 tokens; multimodality enters through the tokenizer, the language-model head remains restricted to text, and the architecture is unchanged. Supervised finetuning, long-context finetuning, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, and preference alignment complete the released models. Thinking is a flag of the chat template rather than a separate model, and lifts mathematical reasoning by up to 20 points on the 8B model. The released models improve over their predecessors on nearly every benchmark; among fully open models of its class, the 8B leads on knowledge, instruction following, and cultural benchmarks, and its instruction following surpasses all compared models, including open-weight ones. On image and audio understanding, a first for the family, the models are competitive with fully open multimodal models, strongest on document understanding and long-form and lower-resource speech recognition, while specialized vision and audio models remain ahead on perception and transcription of English and other high-resource languages. As in Apertus 1.0, we train only on openly available data, respect crawler opt-outs retroactively, and exclude restrictively licensed material. We release the model weights, data preparation and training recipes, and evaluation suites under permissive licenses; openness extends to values, with the Apertus charter guiding alignment stages published alongside the models.

REPRO: Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimizer for Automated LLM Red-Teaming
REPRO：用于自动化LLM红队测试的反思进化提示优化器
Safety-aligned large language models (LLMs) remain vulnerable to adversarial prompts that bypass their safety training. Existing automated red-teaming methods either require privileged access unavailable in production, rely on manually engineered per-model templates, or optimize a single objective without population-level diversity. We present REPRO (Reflective Evolutionary Prompt Optimization), a pure black-box framework that discovers adversarial prompts through evolutionary optimization driven entirely by a compressed open-weight 7B reflective model on a single consumer GPU. REPRO introduces two mechanisms absent from prior work, both isolated in a component ablation: semantic crossover, an LLM-guided multi-parent recombination operator, and Bayesian strategy selection via Thompson Sampling informed by structured failure analysis. We catalog REPRO's behavior on AdvBench, JailbreakBench, and HarmBench across 36 target models from 11 families, including GPT-5-nano, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, Gemini-2.5-Pro, and Grok-4.1. Under our protocol REPRO reaches 100\% attack success rate (ASR) on every evaluated target in a single turn, at a median of 24 target queries per behavior. Two properties of the protocol qualify that figure. The judge scoring candidates during optimization also produces the reported ASR, and search halts when it accepts, so ASR reports whether search succeeded within the iteration budget rather than success at a fixed budget. All baseline figures are transcribed from their original papers, which use different judges, budgets, and model versions. We therefore present this as a catalog of model coverage under one protocol rather than a head-to-head ranking, and develop both qualifications in the paper.

AlphaPilot：基于强化学习的多轮工具使用大语言模型智能体用于自适应阿尔法挖掘
Formulaic alpha mining seeks interpretable expressions that rank assets by future returns. The task is challenging because it demands simultaneous processing of unstructured market descriptions, historical data, and quantitative evaluation of candidate factors, yet most existing methods exploit only a subset of these signals. We introduce AlphaPilot, a reinforcement-learning framework that trains multi-turn tool-using LLM agents for adaptive alpha mining. The agent conditions on market descriptions, proposes factor expressions, queries real-data evaluator feedback, and updates a retained factor pool across turns. This design jointly leverages market text, LLM financial knowledge, real data, and evaluation feedback. At inference time, AlphaPilot performs day-by-day search and pool updates to adapt to shifting market regimes. Across three independent runs in out-of-sample rolling backtests on CSI300 and CSI500, AlphaPilot achieves mean total returns of 42.93% and 54.19%, with mean Sharpe ratios of 2.46 and 2.86, respectively. It attains the highest mean total return, Sharpe, and RankIC among the evaluated methods on both universes.

Large Language Models (LLMs) have made substantial progress in multilingual question answering, yet their ability to understand low-resource sociolinguistic contexts remains under-explored. We study North Korea as a unique testbed where decades of division have produced distinct differences from South Korea in vocabulary, orthography, norms, and ideological discourse. We introduce LENS (Language and sociocultural Evaluation for North Korean Society), a human-validated benchmark of 1,765 questions evaluating LLMs across three dimensions: linguistic robustness, sociocultural perspective alignment, and domain-specific knowledge. Qualitative analysis reveals that models often conflate formal institutions with lived realities, project liberal-democratic assumptions, or rely on coarse stereotypes. Our results demonstrate that linguistic similarity alone does not guarantee sociocultural or domain-specific understanding, highlighting the critical need for grounded evaluation resources for underrepresented cultural and political contexts.

Sequent-Prover: Training Agents for Formal, Checkable SMT-based Reasoning

We introduce Sequent-Prover, a family of verifier-using language-model agents, and the post-training framework that produces them. Agents reason in an executable SMT-LIB scratchpad: they write complete SMT-LIB programs, query Z3 across turns, inspect solver feedback, repair formalizations, and terminate with an explicit answer. Our recipe, verifier-conditioned trajectory distillation, bootstraps from a noisy teacher proposal policy by sampling multi-turn trajectories, retaining the successful tail that is correct, non-trivial, grounded, and executable, then applying supervised fine-tuning and trajectory-level preference optimization. Because solver success alone does not guarantee semantic faithfulness, we evaluate task accuracy, k-sample reliability, and SMT program quality. Across 37 benchmarks and 7,254 problems per model family, post-training raises the 4B model's per-attempt accuracy from 85.6% to 97.0% and four-sample all-correct reliability (pass^4}) from 64.1% to 91.7%. It also reduces average SMT calls from 4.10 to 2.52 and tokens per attempt from 18.97k to 12.72k. Sequent-Prover agents give answers backed by executable formal artifacts.

SAFE-KV: Causal Suffix Repair for Behavior-Preserving Non-Prefix KV Cache Reuse in RAG

Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) reuses the same documents across many requests, making non-prefix KV-cache reuse attractive. Yet a cached document state is not reusable text: it is a context-conditioned causal state whose keys and values depend on the prefix, position, and preceding documents under which it was computed. We formulate non-prefix KV reuse as a behavior-preservation problem with full prefill on the exact prompt as the reference, and introduce SAFE-KV, which repairs a composed cache by re-encoding the causal suffix from a selected start document. On Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, prefix-conditioned composition preserves only 47.2% of HotpotQA-500 and 37.8% of 2Wiki-500 full-prefill answers; SAFE-KV with risk-guided K2 selection restores 99.8%/98.4% (donor-copy protocol) and 100.0%/98.4% with actual suffix forwarding. Document-only and fixed-window repairs recover far less, because the document states after the repaired region keep histories that omit it. Reuse without repair is exact up to four documents and degrades at sixteen, where suffix repair recovers 98-100%. Faithful repair re-encodes most of the context, so in a single-request L40S study SAFE-KV's operating rule serves every workload by full prefill. SAFE-KV thus establishes the causal-state contract for non-prefix reuse and a validated repair mechanism that meets it.

检索增强生成（RAG）在多个请求间重用相同文档，使得非前缀KV缓存重用具有吸引力。然而，缓存的文档状态并非可重用文本：它是一种依赖于前缀、位置及先前文档的上下文条件因果状态。我们将非前缀KV重用建模为一个行为保持问题，以完整预填充精确提示作为参考，并引入SAFE-KV，通过重新编码从选定起始文档出发的因果后缀来修复组合缓存。在Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct上，基于前缀的组合仅保留47.2%的HotpotQA-500和37.8%的2Wiki-500完整预填充答案；而采用风险引导的K2选择策略，SAFE-KV恢复至99.8%/98.4%（捐赠复制协议）和100.0%/98.4%（实际后缀转发）。仅文档或固定窗口修复效果差得多，因为修复区域之后的状态仍保留了缺失历史。无修复重用仅在最多四份文档时准确，十六份时性能下降，而后缀修复可恢复98%-100%。忠实修复重新编码了大部分上下文，因此在单请求L40S研究中，SAFE-KV的操作规则可通过完整预填充满足所有工作负载。SAFE-KV因此确立了非前缀重用的因果状态契约，并提供了一个经过验证的修复机制以满足该契约。

UDHRBench: Benchmarking Human Rights in Large Language Models
UDHRBench：大语言模型中人权基准测试
Large language models are increasingly deployed in contexts requiring adherence to ethical and legal norms, yet their alignment with internationally recognized human rights standards remains underexplored. We introduce UDHRBench, a large-scale benchmark for operationalising the evaluation of large language model compliance with the Universal Declaration of Human Rights. The dataset comprises 1,124 human rights confronting questions covering all 30 articles and 4,496 responses from four large language models (ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, and Fanar), manually annotated by experts for alignment, with high inter-annotator agreement ($κ= 0.801$). Our analysis reveals systematic and non-trivial misalignments, showing that violations typically arise through seemingly rational reasoning: appeals to efficiency, risk management, or scientific neutrality, rather than explicit rejection of rights. We further propose an LLM-as-a-Judge framework for automated evaluation using zero-shot and few-shot prompting, achieving 89.8\% weighted F1-score in detecting human-rights misalignment, alongside a novel Alignment Leniency Score that quantifies how judge models resolve ambiguous cases. The dataset, annotations, and code will be released as open-source resources (https://sina.birzeit.edu/UDHRBench).
中文翻译
大语言模型越来越多地被部署于需要遵守伦理和法律规范的场景中，但其与国际公认的人权标准的一致性仍缺乏深入探索。我们提出UDHRBench，一个大规模基准，用于操作化评估大语言模型对《世界人权宣言》的合规性。该数据集包含覆盖全部30条条款的1,124个人权相关问题，以及来自四个大语言模型（ChatGPT、Grok、Gemini和Fanar）的4,496个回答，由专家手动标注对齐情况，具有较高的评分者间一致性（κ=0.801）。我们的分析揭示了系统性且非平凡的偏差，显示违规通常源于看似合理的推理：如效率诉求、风险管理或科学中立性，而非明确拒绝权利。我们进一步提出了LLM-as-a-Judge框架，通过零样本和少样本提示实现自动化评估，检测人权偏差的加权F1得分为89.8%，并提出一种新颖的“对齐宽容度评分”来量化裁判模型在模糊案例中的处理方式。数据集、标注和代码将作为开源资源发布（https://sina.birzeit.edu/UDHRBench）。

A language model's ability to solve a task individually does not ensure that a team can solve it under unequal access to information and communication. SANZARU examines this gap through cooperative bomb-defusal puzzles adapted from BOMBANANA! (Lefto Studio, 2026). Task information and action authority are divided among three agents: one cannot hear, another cannot speak, and the third cannot see. The benchmark contains 120 puzzle instances across seven families, each targeting a distinct coordination ability. Across 1512 episodes, 7 models achieve an overall success rate of 49%, ranging from 20% to 86% under the evaluated configurations. Teams develop or adopt diverse communication protocols, from simple gesture codes to Morse and encodings of entire manuals. Yet trace analysis attributes about 60% of 771 team losses to communication, and agents attempt to use channels unavailable to their teammates despite explicit role instructions. Together, task outcomes and interaction traces enable evaluation of both collaborative performance and perspective taking throughout cooperation. The benchmark is available at https://github.com/markli404/sanzaru-benchmark.

Lumen-bench: Cross-Lingual Safety Gaps and the Say-Do Problem in Tool-Calling Large Language Models
Lumen-bench：工具调用大语言模型中的跨语言安全差距与说行不一问题
When a large language model refuses an unethical request, what does refusal mean? In conversation, refusal is bounded by what the model says; once the model is equipped with executable tools, what it does can diverge from what it says, a failure mode that English-only evaluations cannot fully reveal. We introduce Lumen-bench, a behavioral benchmark of tool-calling ethics spanning 30 models, five languages (Portuguese, English, Spanish, Mandarin Chinese, Hindi), 108 Portuguese-authored scenarios, six social-pressure conditions, two system prompts (ethical and neutral), and 21 generic tools. The evaluation comprises 194,400 trials. Judgments come from a reasoning-model judge (o4-mini), calibrated against one Portuguese-speaking author ($n=83$; harmful/non-harmful $κ=0.78$), compared with two other provider judges (Fleiss' $κ=0.78$, $n=607$), and complemented by retrospective sandbox replay. Four findings emerge. (i) Within-model comparisons support higher harmful-action rates in Hindi and Portuguese than English under the ethical prompt, and Hindi and Spanish under the neutral prompt, after multiple-testing correction. (ii) Premium models have lower median violation rates, although price does not guarantee safety or competence. (iii) Replacing the ethical system prompt with a neutral one raises pooled violation rates from 2.76\% to 13.64\%. (iv) In 8.57\% of substantive-call cases, refusal or ethical objection accompanies a harmful tool call: the judges consistently identify the say-do gap, although they differ in how many responses they assign to this category. Matched benign controls demonstrate legitimate task completion in 82.8\% of 3,300 trials. Code and reproduction scripts are available at https://github.com/TropicAI-Research/lumen.
中文翻译
当大语言模型拒绝一项不道德请求时，拒绝意味着什么？在对话中，拒绝受限于模型所说的；但一旦模型配备了可执行工具，其行为可能与其言辞相悖，这种失效模式无法通过仅限英语的评估完全揭示。我们引入Lumen-bench，一个涵盖30个模型、五种语言（葡萄牙语、英语、西班牙语、中文普通话、印地语）、108个由葡萄牙语作者撰写的场景、六种社会压力条件、两种系统提示（伦理型和中立型）以及21个通用工具的行为基准测试。评估包含194,400次试验。判断由一个推理模型裁判（o4-mini）完成，经过一位葡萄牙语母语作者校准（n=83；有害/非有害κ=0.78），并与另外两位提供者裁判对比（Fleiss' κ=0.78，n=607），并辅以事后沙盒回放。四个发现浮现：(i) 同模型比较显示，在伦理提示下，印地语和葡萄牙语模型的有害行为率高于英语；在中立提示下，印地语和西班牙语模型的有害行为率更高，经多重检验校正后成立。(ii) 高端模型的中位违规率更低，但价格并不保证安全或能力。(iii) 将伦理系统提示替换为中立提示，合并违规率从2.76%上升至13.64%。(iv) 在8.57%的实际调用案例中，拒绝或道德反对伴随有害工具调用：裁判一致识别出“说行不一”现象，尽管他们对该类别响应数量的划分有所不同。匹配的良性对照组在3,300次试验中有82.8%成功完成任务。代码和复现脚本可在https://github.com/TropicAI-Research/lumen获取。

Relevant facts are scattered across long, legally dense texts, and traceability of extracted facts to their source is essential for verification. With increasing awareness of the environmental and health impacts of per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), regulatory documents have expanded significantly, varying in scope and product relevance, making interpretation challenging for manufacturers and policymakers. Through experiments with open- and closed-source LLMs across prompting strategies, document condensing methods, and schema partitioning approaches, we find that document identification fields remain challenging, and that field-specific few-shot examples improve extraction. This work lays the groundwork for AI tools for hazardous substance identification, question answering, and compliance monitoring. The code and data are available at https://github.com/IBM/PFAS-regulations.

Automated disease classification from patient-reported symptoms requires balancing the speed of lightweight discriminative models against the contextual understanding and latency costs of autoregressive large language models (LLMs). Decision foundation models offer an alternative by mapping representations directly to candidate classes without free-form text generation. We adapt Clef-Flash, a 9-billion-parameter decision model built on a Qwen3.5 backbone, for 24-class disease classification on the Symptom2Disease benchmark. Using 4-bit quantized low-rank adaptation (QLoRA) with differential learning rates and a stratified split of 960 training and 240 test cases, the model achieves 95.42% diagnostic accuracy and a macro F1 score of 0.9551. This improves upon the reported zero-shot baselines of 61.67% for a remote API and 65.00% for a local unadapted initialization, and outperforms the ClinicalBERT baseline (90.90%). By evaluating candidate logits in a single forward pass without autoregressive decoding, inference takes under 80 milliseconds per record on a single GPU, yielding a reported 31-fold speedup over generative LLM baselines. To examine symptom-level evidence, we introduce a Leave-One-Symptom-Out (LOSO) counterfactual perturbation framework. Removing disease-defining symptom clauses in a psoriasis example reduces predicted-class confidence from 100.00% to 0.12% and shifts the prediction to impetigo with 99.59% confidence, while removing secondary systemic symptoms produces less than 0.01% change in confidence. UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training

Recent bidirectional encoders have been modernized with innovations from causal large language models (LLMs). However, the pretraining recipe itself remains inherited from small-scale conventions, leaving encoders underoptimized, with no single model performing competitively across both classification and retrieval tasks. In this work, we investigate how far encoder performance can be pushed by revisiting core design choices in training, revealing three key findings: (1) Encoders saturate on downstream tasks beyond a few trillion tokens, indicating that additional compute past this point does not help. (2) Across model sizes, lower masking ratios benefit classification while higher ones benefit retrieval, contradicting prior work suggesting larger ratios for larger models. (3) Distillation with pruning improves classification at low masking ratios but degrades retrieval at high ones. Guided by these findings, we present UltraBERT, a single encoder that assigns separate LM heads to low and high masking ratios within a batch and restricts the distillation objective to the low ratio. To our knowledge, UltraBERT is the first encoder to achieve state of the art on both classification and retrieval tasks, reaching 91.0 on GLUE and 47.7 on BEIR. Together, these results show how far encoder performance can be pushed and provide a principled basis for compute allocation, masking ratio design, and knowledge transfer in bidirectional models.

Emotion-Cause Pair Extraction (ECPE) requires identifying the causes associated with emotions expressed in a conversation. Accurate extraction can depend on evidence that is not initially available, making it important to decide when further information is worth acquiring. We study agent-guided evidence acquisition for ECPE, where a student agent selectively accesses expert judgments for borderline relations on both sides of its validation-selected F1 decision boundary and revises only queried predictions. Through controlled comparisons under different information-access conditions, we examine how delegation granularity, query selection, and response integration affect prediction quality. At a nominal 10% query rate, selective fusion improves mean pair F1 by 2.64-3.88 points over the student in our main experiments, reaching 65.14 on ECF and 49.74 on MEC4 across model families. Our analysis suggests that greater access does not always translate into better cause identification. These findings motivate acquisition strategies that consider both the relevance of newly available evidence and its effect on prediction revision, providing an empirical basis for more effective and efficient evidence acquisition in ECPE.

Who Receives Respect? A Counterfactual Benchmark for Honorific Allocation Bias in Bengali
谁应受到尊重？针对孟加拉语敬语分配偏见的反事实基准测试
Bengali has no grammatical gender, but honorificity is obligatory: every third-person reference must choose ordinary or respectful register. English has no such signal, so the system must choose a level of deference that the source never specified. We use this property to measure how large language models (LLMs) allocate respect in English--Bengali translation. Our evaluation set contains 2{,}016 sentences across 72 occupations. Each appears in seven sentence frames under four pronoun conditions. Masculine and feminine versions differ by one word, forming counterfactual pairs. We report a single Honorific Bias Score (HBS) for each model on a 0--100 scale, covering both the gender and occupation axes. A lower score means that respect is allocated more evenly. For the occupation analysis, we compute each occupation's honorific rate across the seven no-pronoun sentence frames. The standard deviation of these 72 occupation-level rates ranges from 17.2 to 35.5 percentage points across models, showing substantial variation in how honorifics are allocated across occupations. Occupation is associated with 3.2\% to 51.5\% of the variance in register choice, compared with at most 1.2\% for gender. Gender effects are much smaller overall: only two of the nine models show significant directional gender gaps, and they favor opposite genders. HBS ranges from 19.9 to 70.1 across the nine models, showing substantial variation in how evenly the models allocate respect.
中文翻译
孟加拉语没有语法性别，但敬语使用是强制性的：每个第三人称指代必须选择普通或尊敬语态。英语没有此类信号，因此系统必须选择一个源语言未指定的尊重程度。我们利用这一特性来衡量大语言模型（LLMs）在英-孟加拉语翻译中如何分配尊重。我们的评估集包含72种职业的2,016个句子，每句在四种代词条件下出现在七个句子框架中。男性和女性版本仅在一个词上不同，形成反事实配对。我们报告每个模型在0-100量表上的单一敬语偏见得分（HBS），涵盖性别和职业两个维度。得分越低，表示尊重分配越均衡。在职业分析中，我们计算了每个职业在七种无代词句子框架下的敬语率。这72个职业层面的率的标准差在各模型间为17.2至35.5个百分点，显示出敬语在职业间的分配存在显著差异。职业对语态选择方差的解释力为3.2%至51.5%，而性别最多仅占1.2%。总体而言，性别影响较小：九个模型中仅有两个表现出显著的方向性性别差距，且偏向相反性别。HBS在九个模型间从19.9到70.1不等，表明模型在尊重分配的均衡性上存在显著差异。

PVFH-Bench: Benchmarking Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models
PVFH-Bench：视觉语言模型中前提诱导视觉凝视幻觉的基准测试
Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable progress across a wide range of multimodal tasks. However, object hallucination remains a persistent challenge, undermining model reliability in applications such as visual question answering, embodied agents, and human-AI decision support systems. In this paper, inspired by cognitive science studies on perceptual bias, we investigate a new failure mode termed Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination (PVFH). Specifically, PVFH refers to a premise-induced reasoning error in which models become anchored to visually confusable evidence, accept a false textual premise, and subsequently generate responses about an absent yet visually plausible object. To systematically study this phenomenon, we introduce PVFH-Bench, a benchmark that automatically constructs visually confusable but absent targets and pairs the core hallucination setting with diagnostic subsets to trace how models move from object recognition to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Experimental results on 10 state-of-the-art LVLMs demonstrate that all evaluated models are highly vulnerable to Premise-Induced Visual Fixation Hallucination. Moreover, we find that explicit chain-of-thought reasoning can further exacerbate this failure mode by encouraging models to overinterpret weak visual cues as supporting evidence for hallucinated objects.
中文翻译
大型视觉语言模型（LVLM）在多种多模态任务中取得了显著进展，但物体幻觉仍是持续存在的挑战，削弱了其在视觉问答、具身智能体和人机决策支持系统等应用中的可靠性。本文受认知科学中感知偏见研究的启发，探讨一种新的失效模式——前提诱导视觉凝视幻觉（PVFH）。具体而言，PVFH指模型因前提诱导而产生推理错误，即被视觉上易混淆的证据所锚定，接受一个虚假的文本前提，并随后生成关于一个不存在但视觉上合理的对象的回答。为系统研究该现象，我们提出了PVFH-Bench，一个自动构建视觉上易混淆但实际不存在的目标的基准，并将核心幻觉场景与诊断子集相结合，追踪模型如何从物体识别演变为前提诱导视觉凝视幻觉。对10个最先进的LVLM的实验结果表明，所有被评估模型均高度易受前提诱导视觉凝视幻觉的影响。此外，我们发现显式的思维链推理可能进一步加剧这一失败模式，因为它促使模型过度解读微弱的视觉线索作为幻觉对象的支持证据。

LongHisDoc: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Chinese Long Historical Document Understanding
LongHisDoc：中文长历史文献理解的综合性基准
Chinese historical documents are invaluable cultural treasures, but their complexity poses significant comprehension challenges for non-specialists. Despite the success of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) in modern document tasks, their capabilities in Long (full-book) Historical Document understanding remain largely unexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce LongHisDoc, the first benchmark tailored for long historical document understanding. LongHisDoc comprises 1,012 expert-annotated QA pairs derived from 101 PDF documents, with an average of 85.1 pages and 42,776.4 tokens per document. It spans 10 categories and features four QA types: single-page, cross-page, multi-hop, and unanswerable. Answering these questions requires integrating multimodal evidence from text, layout, and visual elements. Our evaluation reveals that the top-performing LVLM and LLM achieve only 62.9% and 69.9% accuracy, respectively, highlighting a substantial performance gap. Furthermore, we assess various modal retrievers and the end-to-end RAG performance to provide references for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems. We believe that LongHisDoc serves as a comprehensive benchmark to catalyze future research in full-book historical document understanding. The benchmark and evaluation code are available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/qweq12433454/LongHisDoc and https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/LongHisDoc.
中文翻译
中文历史文献是宝贵的文化遗产，但其复杂性给非专业人士带来了巨大的理解挑战。尽管大语言模型（LLM）和大视觉语言模型（LVLM）在现代文档任务中取得成功，但在长篇（整本书籍）历史文献理解方面的能力仍基本未被探索。为弥合这一差距，我们推出了LongHisDoc，首个专为长历史文献理解设计的基准。LongHisDoc包含从101份PDF文档中提取的1,012个专家标注的问答对，平均每份文档85.1页，约42,776.4个词元，涵盖10个类别，包含四种问答类型：单页、跨页、多跳和无法回答。解答这些问题需要整合来自文本、版式和视觉元素的多模态证据。我们的评估显示，表现最佳的LVLM和LLM准确率分别仅为62.9%和69.9%，凸显了显著的性能差距。此外，我们评估了多种模态检索器及端到端RAG性能，为检索增强生成（RAG）系统提供参考。我们认为，LongHisDoc将成为推动未来全书历史文献理解研究的综合性基准。基准与评估代码可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/qweq12433454/LongHisDoc 和 https://github.com/SCUT-DLVCLab/LongHisDoc 获取。

SciCurateBench: Curating Experimental Data from Heterogeneous Scientific Literature with Verbal-Action Agents
SciCurateBench：通过语言-动作代理从异构科学文献中整理实验数据
Scientific research increasingly depends on curating experimental data from literature. Scientific data curation requires verifying exact experimental conditions (e.g., specific assays, clinical outcomes, and data availability) across long, heterogeneous files, which is a highly time-consuming process. Existing benchmarks evaluate only broad relevance on short queries, failing to capture this complexity. We introduce SciCurateBench, a benchmark of 200 expert-annotated papers from major life-science journals that challenges systems to verify conjunctive biological experimental criteria from raw, unprocessed scientific literature. We show that plain LLMs and popular reasoning, tool-using, and feedback-based agents all struggle with this task. To study what makes the task tractable, we further propose LangPoli, an integrative system in which a policy agent generates natural language action guidelines that actor agents convert into executable tools. LangPoli showed strong performance on both Paper Classification (83.16% F1 vs. 58.22% for its base LLM) and Structured Information Retrieval, and also improves re-ranking on the public benchmarks of LitSearch, BEIR, and TREC. We further explore curriculum transfer, a method that distills generalizable strategies from solved tasks to accelerate the solving of related problems. We hope this work facilitates research in truly practical scientific AI assistance. The anonymized pre-release can be found from https://anonymous.4open. science/r/scicuratebench-D885/.

Enterprise customer-support agents increasingly rely on Large Language Models (LLMs) to execute bounded, tool-using workflows. We study this problem through the lens of Skill LLMs: specialized executors that operate within a selected skill context and must complete a narrow, stateful workflow under policy and tool constraints. We present a benchmark construction pipeline that mines recurrent workflows from real-world transcripts, converts them into structured skill descriptions, maps them to tool requirements, simulates environment state with Model Context Protocol (MCP)-compatible mocks, and generates multi-turn tool-using dialogues. Using this benchmark, we conduct a large-scale zero-shot evaluation of 17 language models spanning closed model families and deployment-oriented open-weight models from 1.7B to 14B parameters, each judged independently by five strong LLM judges, plus a deterministic rule-based evaluator that checks tool coverage, hallucinated tool use, and unsupported claims. We find a consistent ranking in which GPT-5.4 leads by a wide margin and QWEN3.5-9B is the strongest open-weight model (below 20B), outperforming several closed baselines under every judge. We also find that judge choice is not a negligible methodological detail: pairwise judge agreement on the pass/fail verdict averages Kappa=0.524 across 10 judge pairs. These results suggest that comprehensive zero-shot evaluation of skill execution requires judge reliability as carefully as model capability.

LLM data engineering requires iterative experimentation to determine how data selection, rewards, and curricula affect model learning, making it a natural setting for AI-for-AI (AI4AI) research. Can agents use experimental feedback to progressively improve strategies, and do the resulting strategies improve target-model performance on held-out data? We study how agents use experimental feedback to develop data-engineering strategies under fixed training and evaluation protocols. Our Agentic Data Engineering (ADE) framework lets agents pursue, revise, or combine research directions using cumulative findings. Strategies are selected by in-loop scores and evaluated on held-out benchmarks. Across four tasks-math and code data selection, math reward design, and math curriculum learning-selected strategies achieve absolute gains over generic baselines of up to 13.34% on AIME25 Pass@32 and 5.85% averaged across four held-out benchmarks under fixed training conditions. In-loop scores improve over successive experiments, while held-out trajectories show that later in-loop gains do not always improve generalization. Comparisons of research organization and feedback access favor combining evidence analysis with cumulative findings. Research trajectories show how earlier findings inform strategy revisions and combinations across research directions.

Does System One Transfer? Calibrated Typed-Decision Models, Label Budgets, and Translation for Indonesian Regional Languages
系统一是否可迁移？校准型类型决策模型、标签预算与印尼地区语言的翻译
Calibrated typed-decision ("System One") models return a label and a probability in a single forward pass at a small fraction of the cost of large language models (LLMs), yet their evaluation has been almost entirely English. We report a pre-registered evaluation of the commercial Jev model and the open Laya-multilingual model on Indonesian regional languages, using the parallel NusaX sentiment (12 languages) and NusaTranslation sentiment and emotion (7 languages) test sets. Jev is more often correct on sentences that are lexically closer to Indonesian in all three datasets, and presenting the human Indonesian translation instead raises its accuracy by up to 37.2 points, most in languages distant from Indonesian. Its expected calibration error does not grow on regional languages, but its ability to rank its own errors degrades in all three datasets. Retrained classifiers need more than 500 labels per language to match zero-shot Jev in 9 of 10 NusaX regional languages. A confidence-gated cascade that sends Jev's 10-30% least confident decisions to a local IndoBERT classifier matches or exceeds the better of the two systems, and routing to an LLM instead matches that LLM at 24-77% lower API cost. Of six further commercial LLMs (three Claude and three GPT models), five are 4-14 points more accurate than Jev, at several hundred times the API cost where it is reported, while the smallest (Claude Haiku) is less accurate. Loose Lips: Understanding Privacy Leakage in Agentic Dialogue
松口：理解代理对话中的隐私泄露问题
As LLM agents are increasingly deployed in high-stakes enterprise settings, understanding how they handle sensitive information in agentic dialogue has become critical. Privacy leakage in such settings requires reasoning about whether information flows respect the contextual norms under which they originated. We extend CIMemories to CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE, a benchmark of 4,410 two-agent dialogue instances grounded in Contextual Integrity theory. Using this benchmark, we systematically evaluate 7 open-weight models from the Qwen3 and Llama 3.1 families across conversation lengths of 1 and 6 turns under three prompting conditions. We find that task capability and privacy leakage are fundamentally coupled: more capable models are systematically leakier, with no model in our evaluation able to decouple the two. Thinking models consistently leak more than their non-thinking counterparts, a pattern we attribute to the extended reasoning surface created by chain-of-thought. Leakage compounds with conversation length, rising up to 3x from 1 to 6 turns. Our results suggest that the coupling between task capability and privacy leakage is not an artifact of misconfiguration but a structural feature of current agentic systems.
中文翻译
随着大语言模型代理在高风险企业场景中日益普及，理解它们在代理对话中如何处理敏感信息变得至关重要。此类场景下的隐私泄露问题需要推理信息流动是否符合其起源背景下的情境完整性规范。我们扩展了 CIMemories，构建了 CIMEMORIES DIALOGUE，这是一个基于情境完整性理论的 4,410 个双代理对话实例基准。利用该基准，我们在三种提示条件下，系统评估了来自 Qwen3 和 Llama 3.1 系列的 7 个开源模型在 1 轮和 6 轮对话长度下的表现。我们发现，任务能力与隐私泄露本质上是耦合的：更强大的模型系统性地更容易泄露信息，我们评估的所有模型均无法解耦二者。思考型模型始终比非思考型模型泄露更多，这一现象我们归因于思维链带来的扩展推理表面。泄露随对话长度增加而加剧，从 1 轮到 6 轮上升至 3 倍。结果表明，任务能力与隐私泄露之间的耦合并非配置错误所致，而是当前代理系统的结构性特征。

PsyBer-Agent: A Psychology-Driven User Agent for Recommender Systems
PsyBer-Agent：面向推荐系统的心理学驱动用户代理
Evaluating recommender systems before deployment requires simulators that remain realistic over long, closed-loop interaction cycles. Current LLM-based agents generally function as surface imitators that generate realistic short-term responses but fail to capture the underlying user dynamics such as fatigue, affect, and shifting preferences. We propose PsyBer-Agent, a psychology-inspired simulator that models these dynamics through its Psy-Engine. This engine represents each user with three evolving, model-defined latent states. To calibrate simulated behavior against real interaction logs, we align log-conditioned reference trajectories with simulator-generated latent-state trajectories via Unbalanced Gromov--Wasserstein optimal transport. This approach provides structured supervision for a lightweight policy without the computational burden of fine-tuning the backbone LLM. We also introduce WebSim and the PsyBer Benchmark, which encompass multimodal scenarios and seven recommender backbones. Our framework evaluates behavioral fidelity, latent-state consistency, robustness, and responses to social-cue perturbations. On the tested horizons, PsyBer-Agent shows lower behavioral discrepancy than the prompt-only simulators while maintaining stable performance under large-scale concurrent simulation for up to 5M queued simulation tasks under bounded concurrency. Code is available in the supplementary material and at: PsyBer-Agent: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CC66F/, WebSim Platform: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/D8EAX/.
中文翻译

The Last Remote Sensing Model Built by Humans? Casting Any Earth Observation Task as Recursive Self-Improvement
人类最后构建的遥感模型？将任何地球观测任务转化为递归自我改进
Earth observation (EO) models are still built by hand. For each new task, experts design a training recipe and tune it against a benchmark. We show that this loop can be handed to an agent. Any verifiable task can be cast as a harness and a verifier, where the harness defines what the agent may use and the verifier defines what counts as success. Every EO task can be made verifiable, through labeled benchmarks, independent sensors, physical models or the repeated observation of the same place. Given only these two components, a general-purpose coding agent builds the EO model and improves it recursively on its own outputs. Settings long treated as separate research problems, from learning with a handful of labels to adapting across domains, become choices of harness and verifier. On four EO benchmarks spanning optical, SAR and multispectral time-series imagery, agent-built models surpass the state of the art and keep most of that accuracy from about 1% of the training labels. This establishes a new paradigm for EO, in which people design harnesses and verifiers and agents build the models, so EO models improve as agents do.

OmniCompass: A Holistic Benchmark for Omni-Modal Video Grounding and Understanding
OmniCompass：面向全模态视频定位与理解的综合性基准
With the rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), evaluating their video understanding capabilities has become increasingly important. Existing video understanding benchmarks cover only part of the evaluation dimensions, limiting systematic diagnosis of omni-modal video understanding. We introduce OmniCompass, a holistic benchmark for omni-modal video grounding and understanding. OmniCompass defines two evaluation tracks: OmniCompass-VL assesses vision-language models on tasks requiring visual evidence, while OmniCompass-AV assesses omni-modal models on tasks requiring joint audio-visual evidence. Each track includes three complementary tasks: temporal grounding (TG), spatial grounding (SG), and question answering (QA), assessing when a referenced target appears, where it is, and what happens. QA covers five perception and three reasoning categories in OmniCompass-VL, and three perception and two reasoning categories in OmniCompass-AV. OmniCompass-VL contains 820 videos and 2,460 instances across domains and three duration types: short, medium, and long. A narrative- and audio-rich subset forms OmniCompass-AV with 240 videos and 720 instances. Each instance is evaluated under two paired settings: text-only and text+image, specifying the same target through text and visual-language guidance. All instances are manually annotated with multi-round quality verification. Evaluations of 50 MLLMs show that open-source models still lag behind proprietary counterparts, particularly in audio-visual understanding. Precise temporal and spatial grounding remains challenging even for leading models, and their predictions still exhibit inconsistencies across the paired target specifications.

随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的快速发展，评估其视频理解能力变得日益重要。现有的视频理解基准仅覆盖部分评估维度，限制了对全模态视频理解的系统性诊断。我们提出OmniCompass，一个面向全模态视频定位与理解的综合性基准。OmniCompass定义两个评估赛道：OmniCompass-VL评估需要视觉证据的视觉-语言模型，OmniCompass-AV评估需要音视频联合证据的全模态模型。每个赛道包含三个互补任务：时间定位（TG）、空间定位（SG）和问答（QA），分别评估目标出现的时间、位置以及发生的情况。QA在OmniCompass-VL中涵盖五类感知和三类推理，在OmniCompass-AV中涵盖三类感知和两类推理。OmniCompass-VL包含820个视频和2,460个实例，覆盖多个领域和三种时长类型：短、中、长。一个叙事性和音频丰富的子集构成OmniCompass-AV，包含240个视频和720个实例。每个实例在两种配对设置下评估：仅文本和文本+图像，通过文本和视觉-语言引导指定相同目标。所有实例均经过多轮人工标注质量验证。对50个MLLMs的评估显示，开源模型仍落后于专有模型，尤其在音视频理解方面。即使领先模型也面临精确的时间和空间定位挑战，且在配对目标规范下的预测仍存在不一致性。

Self-Evolving Agent Harness
自演化智能体约束器
Harness self-evolution revises an agent's software scaffolding, including prompts, memory, workflows, and executable components, while keeping model weights fixed. We formalize a feedback-driven process in which accepted revisions persist across runs. The framework separates update targets from proposal and admission mechanisms. It distinguishes changes to interpreted state from revisions to tools and code, repository-level control logic, and plugin composition. We characterize search through evolutionary optimization and examine its reliability through continual PAC-learning. Under explicit assumptions, the analysis yields an expected generalization bound, a retention bound conditional on historical regression budgets, and a high-probability admission rule using fresh, independent validation data. We examine how persistent harness revisions affect knowledge sharing and organizational workflows, with implications for scientific reliability, physical safety, and institutional accountability. Cases from prior work illustrate model--harness co-design, distributed execution, and plugin reuse. Reliable deployment requires continual validation as task distributions and evaluators change, with independent safeguards for learning, runtime privileges, and consequential actions. We provide a comprehensive 66-page discussion of related work, theory, algorithms, evaluation, applications, and the broader impact of Harness RSI, together with continuously updated code and supplementary materials, at https://github.com/zgcagi/Harness-RSI.

DoubtLess: Training-Free Contrastive Decoding for Efficient Reasoning
DoubtLess：无需训练的对比解码以实现高效推理
Reasoning models achieve strong performance through long chains of thought (CoT), but often spend more tokens than needed to solve a problem. Existing ways to shorten the CoT require additional training for each model, add a fixed steering vector to the model's hidden states, or use decoding heuristics such as stopping early or banning words like "wait", which can reduce accuracy. We propose DoubtLess, a training-free decoding method in which a much smaller reasoning model steers the large one towards brevity. The small model reads the large model's CoT so far twice, once prompted to be brief (the brief thinker) and once prompted to be verbose (the verbose thinker), and the difference between its two logit vectors, scaled by a strength, is added to the large model's logits at every step of the CoT. On seven benchmarks of competition mathematics, graduate-level science and competitive programming, DoubtLess shortens the CoT of Qwen3-32B by 31% with unchanged accuracy, outperforming five inference-time baselines. We also show that DoubtLess reduces thinking tokens per turn by 20% in a self-debugging coding agent with unchanged task performance. It also generalizes to two other model families with unchanged accuracy. When combined with training-based compression, it further shortens the CoT of a model already trained for brevity. Ablations and behavioral analysis show that DoubtLess reduces repeated checking, with most token savings coming after the correct answer first appears in the CoT. Our code is available at https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess.
中文翻译
推理模型通过长链思维（CoT）实现强大性能，但往往消耗过多token来解决问题。现有缩短CoT的方法需要为每个模型额外训练，或向模型隐藏状态添加固定引导向量，或使用解码启发式策略（如提前停止、禁止某些词汇如“wait”），这些方法可能降低准确性。我们提出DoubtLess，一种无需训练的解码方法，其中一个小规模推理模型引导大规模模型追求简洁性。小模型两次读取大模型当前的CoT：一次被提示简洁（简略思考者），一次被提示冗长（冗长思考者），并将两者logit向量的差值按强度缩放后，加到大模型每一步的logits中。在七项竞赛数学、研究生级科学和编程竞赛基准测试中，DoubtLess使Qwen3-32B的CoT长度减少31%且准确率不变，优于五种推理时基线方法。我们还证明，在自调试编码代理中，DoubtLess将每轮思考token减少20%，任务性能不变。该方法还能泛化至其他两个模型家族且准确率不变。当与基于训练的压缩方法结合时，进一步缩短已为简洁性训练过的模型的CoT。消融实验与行为分析表明，DoubtLess减少了重复检查，大部分token节省发生在正确答案首次出现在CoT之后。代码已公开于https://github.com/leoluolol/DoubtLess。

Hybrid Reasoning Agents
混合推理智能体
How can we build an agent that thinks beyond human language, yet still acts through it in the external environment? Modern LLM agents still reason and interact through text, while latent reasoning offers an efficient internal medium but lacks native tool access and reasoning transparency. We bridge these two directions with Hybrid Reasoning Agents (HybridAgents), which dynamically navigate between latent reasoning and text-based interaction throughout a unified generation process. Architecturally, a lightweight HybridLink enables seamless transitions between text and latent modes, while the agent's continuous working memory preserves lossless hybrid context across multiple turns. These designs preserve tool-integrated agentic capabilities while making latent thoughts directly inspectable. Building on this architecture, we further develop dedicated post-training algorithms for hybrid reasoning: HybridSFT stabilizes tool-integrated hybrid generation by teaching the backbone to coordinate with HybridLink, then HybridRL scales reasoning by learning when to think in latent space and when to act through text. We evaluate HybridAgent at 3 model scales across 11 benchmarks covering mathematics, science, medicine, search, and agentic reasoning. Compared with frontier LLM Agents and agentic frameworks spanning both text-based and latent methods, HybridAgent consistently improves performance by 10.4%, while delivering 35.5%-54.7% token reduction, 1.8x-2.6x faster inference, and 2.7x-3.7x cost savings. Code and data are available at https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent.
中文翻译
如何构建一个能够超越人类语言进行思考，但仍通过语言在外部环境中行动的智能体？现代大型语言模型（LLM）智能体仍通过文本进行推理与交互，而潜空间推理虽具高效性，却缺乏原生工具访问能力和推理透明性。我们通过混合推理智能体（HybridAgents）弥合这两个方向，使其在统一生成过程中动态切换潜空间推理与基于文本的交互。在架构上，轻量级HybridLink实现了文本与潜空间模式间的无缝转换，而智能体的连续工作记忆则保留了多轮对话中的无损混合上下文。这些设计在保持工具集成的智能体能力的同时，使潜空间思考过程可直接观察。基于此架构，我们进一步开发了专门的后训练算法用于混合推理：HybridSFT通过教导主干模型与HybridLink协同，稳定了工具集成的混合生成；HybridRL则通过学习何时在潜空间思考、何时通过文本行动，提升了推理能力。我们在三个模型规模下，对11个涵盖数学、科学、医学、搜索和智能体推理的基准进行了评估。相比前沿LLM智能体及跨文本与潜空间方法的智能体框架，HybridAgent性能平均提升10.4%，同时实现35.5%-54.7%的token减少、1.8x-2.6x的推理加速以及2.7x-3.7x的成本节约。代码与数据已公开于https://github.com/togethercomputer/HybridAgent。

From Relation-Specific Heads to Shared Interventions: Contextual Entrainment in Language Models
从特定关系头到共享干预：语言模型中的上下文同调机制
Large language models rely on prompt context to perform in-context learning, follow formats, and adapt to local evidence. This ability, however, also raises a robustness concern: models may reuse irrelevant tokens from earlier context when answering a later query. Prior work identifies this behavior as contextual entrainment and finds attention heads whose ablation reduces it, arguing that these heads are largely task- or relation-specific. But are the mechanisms behind contextual entrainment truly isolated by relation, or do relation-conditioned searches recover reusable components shared across relations? Using factual-distractor relation-completion prompts across 19 lexical-semantic subtypes, we identify attention heads whose ablation reduces entrainment and test how the resulting head sets transfer recovery ability across exact relations, semantic families, and mixed relation distributions. Same-family transfer exceeds different-family transfer, family residuals weaken once globally shared heads are removed, and subtype-specific searches repeatedly rediscover many global heads. Clean-completion and context-use probes further suggest that this shared intervention can reduce harmful copying while preserving ordinary relation completion and simple in-context abilities. Our findings provide a more precise perspective on contextual entrainment and its mitigation: harmful context following is not best addressed by searching for isolated relation-specific circuits, but by using heterogeneous attack prompts to reveal reusable intervention targets whose effects are shaped by semantic relation structure.
中文翻译
大型语言模型依赖提示上下文进行上下文学习、遵循格式并适应局部证据。然而，这种能力也引发稳健性问题：模型在回答后续问题时可能重复使用早期上下文中无关的标记。先前研究将此行为称为上下文同调，并识别出通过消融可减少该现象的注意力头，认为这些头主要是任务或关系特异性的。但上下文同调的机制是否真的由关系隔离？还是关系条件搜索能恢复跨关系共享的可复用组件？我们使用19种词法-语义子类型的事实-干扰关系补全提示，识别出可减少同调的注意力头，并测试这些头集在相同关系、语义家族及混合关系分布间的迁移能力。同族迁移优于跨族迁移，一旦移除全局共享头，家族残差减弱，子类型特异性搜索反复重新发现多个全局头。干净补全和上下文使用探测进一步表明，这种共享干预可减少有害复制，同时保留普通关系补全和简单上下文学习能力。我们的发现为上下文同调及其缓解提供了更精确的视角：有害的上下文跟随不应通过寻找孤立的关系特异性电路来解决，而应使用异构攻击提示揭示可复用的干预目标，其效果受语义关系结构塑造。

SMI: Ontology-Grounded Semantic IDs for Hierarchy-Aware Medical Concept Representation
SMI：基于本体的语义ID用于层次感知的医学概念表示
Biomedical language models (LMs) provide strong representations for clinical tasks, but they often fail to capture the hierarchical structure among medical concepts. This limitation is especially pronounced for rare and fine-grained clinical codes in long-tailed vocabularies, where hierarchy-agnostic LM representations become less informative as concept frequency decreases. We introduce Semantic Medical Identifier (SMI), a training-free framework for constructing ontology-grounded Semantic IDs and hierarchy-aware medical concept representations. For each diagnosis, procedure, or medication concept, SMI defines its Semantic ID as the coarse-to-fine path through an expert-defined medical ontology. SMI then aggregates frozen biomedical LM embeddings across the corresponding ontology levels to form hierarchy-aware medical concept representations that preserve coarse-to-fine clinical semantics. The base SMI uses uniform aggregation across ontology levels, while a level-weighted variant selects global level weights on validation data. Our theoretical analysis shows that SMI yields more informative medical concept representations than hierarchy-agnostic LM embeddings, particularly for rare and fine-grained clinical concepts. Experiments show that SMI captures meaningful hierarchical structure and improves clinical relation prediction. On MIMIC-IV, SMI improves mortality prediction, readmission prediction, drug recommendation, and rare drug prediction. On eICU, SMI yields more robust patient representations under cross-hospital distribution shift.

Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
知识图谱作为文件：一个工具创建与使用共同演化的智能体沙盒
Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.
中文翻译
在富含文本的知识图谱中进行搜索，需要沿着关系链追踪并检查文本证据。预定义的图谱接口限制了智能体可访问的证据范围，即使它们编写代码来组合工具调用或处理检索到的子图。我们提出了直接知识图谱交互（DKGI），一种智能体沙盒，在其中语言模型智能体可以直接在完整的节点和边文件上创建图谱访问工具。智能体编写Python代码以遵循关系、合并节点集合并选择文本证据，同时穿插执行shell搜索和文件检查。这使智能体能够批量处理大量节点，同时返回选定文本供模型评估。执行反馈指导工具的创建与修改，而不断演化的工具决定了智能体下一步将收集哪些证据。在涵盖三个领域的基准数据集上，无需训练的DKGI在每个图谱上的Hit@1指标均比最强的已有基线高出至少6.7分，即使使用最小化的沙盒配置也是如此。受控消融实验表明，多轮编程相比仅使用shell访问或预定义图谱工具具有优势；轨迹分析显示智能体通过修改代码来扩展搜索或修正错误。这些发现突显了在图谱搜索过程中允许工具创建与使用共同演化的价值。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI获取。

Jev-ToM: Evaluating Theory of Mind in Typed Decision Models
Jev-ToM：在类型化决策模型中评估心智理论
Dialogue and collaborative assistants repeatedly judge what a partner knows, believes, or intends. Typed decision models offer a potential alternative to generative large language models for bounded Theory of Mind (ToM) selection. We present Jev-ToM, comparing five typed decision models and seven generative baselines on 11,117 English text questions from nine ToM benchmarks across six capability groups. TypeSafe Jev reaches 73.2% source-balanced accuracy including native controls and ranks first or second across all six capabilities, leading beliefs, goals/desires/intentions, and emotions. Other typed models show distinct strengths across tasks. Separate resource comparisons suggest that Jev could reduce the cost and waiting time of repeated ToM selection. Confidence-based selection remains benchmark-dependent, and supplied reasons can repair errors or overturn correct answers depending on their attachment. Candidate expansion reveals distinct selection and output-validity problems. Related-question cues account for most of Jev's downstream gains, with task-dependent effects from predicted states. The findings motivate testing Jev as a ToM selection component in assistants, with task-specific confidence calibration, candidate design, and output validation as integration priorities.
中文翻译
对话与协作助手反复判断对方知道、相信或意图什么。类型化决策模型为有界心智理论（ToM）选择提供了一种替代生成式大语言模型的潜在方案。我们提出Jev-ToM，对比五种类型化决策模型与七种生成式基线在来自九个ToM基准的11,117个英文文本问题上的表现，覆盖六个能力组。TypeSafe Jev在包含原生对照的源平衡准确率上达到73.2%，在所有六项能力中排名第一或第二，尤其在信念、目标/欲望/意图和情绪方面表现突出。其他类型化模型在不同任务中展现出各自的优势。独立资源比较表明，Jev可降低重复ToM选择的成本和等待时间。基于置信度的选择仍具有基准依赖性，提供的理由可能修复错误或推翻正确答案，具体取决于其附着方式。候选扩展揭示了选择和输出有效性方面的问题。相关问题提示是Jev下游性能提升的主要原因，而预测状态则产生任务依赖性影响。研究结果促使将Jev作为助手中的ToM选择组件进行测试，集成优先事项包括任务特定的置信度校准、候选设计和输出验证。

From Hindsight to Foresight: Dissecting Clinical Evidence Acquisition in Large Language Models
从 hindsight 到 foresight：剖析大语言模型在临床证据获取中的表现
Large language models (LLMs) often diagnose full sight, static clinical cases well yet struggle in foresight, dynamic diagnosis. Prior work has improved this limitation by quantifying the information models acquire and by developing stronger follow-up strategies to improve diagnostic accuracy. In contrast, we introduce a distinctive hindsight to systematically dissect why LLMs fail to acquire diagnostically critical evidence, tracing the failure from evidence identification, utilization and downstream diagnostic updating through not only diagnostic accuracy, but also evidence coverage, trajectory dynamics, and elicited probability and information entropy. Starting experiments from the breakdown at the level of capabilities, to the diagnosis of the pre-event state before the evidence arrives, and to the post-event state transition after the evidence arrives, our research has revealed the profound limitations and internal causes existing in the dynamic diagnostic process. At the same time, we have also conducted sufficient verification and generalization experiments to prove that these limitations are widespread. Together, these findings shift the central challenge from whether LLMs possess relevant clinical knowledge to whether they can identify, acquire, and effectively use the right evidence under clinical diagnosis and conduct a more detailed mechanism analysis to identify the exact location of the capability gap.
中文翻译
大语言模型（LLMs）在诊断静态、完整的临床病例方面表现良好，但在动态诊断的前瞻性判断上却表现不佳。以往研究通过量化模型获取的信息并开发更强的后续策略来提升诊断准确性。相比之下，我们提出一种独特的 hindsight 方法，系统性地剖析 LLMs 在获取关键诊断证据时失败的原因，从证据识别、利用到下游诊断更新的全过程进行分析，不仅关注诊断准确率，还考察证据覆盖度、轨迹动态性、诱发的概率与信息熵等维度。实验从能力层面的分解开始，延伸至证据到达前的预事件状态诊断，以及证据到达后的后事件状态转变，揭示了动态诊断过程中深层的局限性及其内在原因。同时，我们进行了充分的验证与泛化实验，证明这些局限具有普遍性。总体而言，这一发现将核心挑战从‘LLMs 是否具备相关临床知识’转变为‘它们是否能在临床诊断中识别、获取并有效使用正确的证据’，并推动更细致的机制分析以定位能力差距的具体位置。

Empathy Is Not the Scapegoat for Declines in Factuality and Reliability
共情并非事实性与可靠性下降的替罪羊
Language models are increasingly expected to support users in stressful or uncertain situations, where warmth and empathy are desirable. While recent work associates warmer models with reduced reliability, we show that this conclusion is incomplete. Prior studies often train primarily on empathetic dialogue, making it difficult to separate tone effects from SFT-induced distribution shift. We revisit this issue at both the model and evaluation levels. We study prompting, SFT, and RL for inducing warm behavior, and comprehensively evaluate capability preservation using an 11-dataset benchmark suite and EMOFACT under emotional contexts. Across multiple model families, we find that warmth effects are task- and model-dependent, while task-aligned adaptive tone can improve empathy and targeted reliability, although some capability trade-offs remain. We further introduce human-validated empathy evaluators specifically developed to assess empathetic model responses. Our results suggest that models can be more supportive in social interactions while remaining reliable.

Retrieval Disagreement as a Signal: Diagnosing and Steering Multilingual Dense Embedders
检索分歧作为信号：诊断与引导多语言密集嵌入模型
Multilingual dense retrievers place all languages in one shared space so that a question finds relevant documents, regardless of which language they are written in. We show that the same question, asked in different languages, retrieves substantially different documents, and this disagreement is not because of weak language understanding. Each language performs well on its own and ranks candidates consistently with the other languages; divergence appears only when languages share an index. We trace the mechanism: each language keeps its own ranking, but in the shared index, its correct answers are pushed far down, buried under non-relevant documents that are either in the query's own language or in English, depending on the model. We introduce disagreement-guided steering: for each language, we contrast the documents that other languages agree on for a question against those that language retrieves idiosyncratically, and take the difference of their representations as a language-specific direction, added to that language's queries at inference. Against baselines of language-mean removal, subspace removal, and per-language rotation, it most strongly reduces same-language crowding while remaining competitive on recall, trading off against mean removal, which better preserves ranking quality.
中文翻译
多语言密集检索器将所有语言置于同一共享空间中，使问题无论用何种语言提出，都能找到相关文档。我们发现，同一问题以不同语言提问时，检索出的文档存在显著差异，这种分歧并非源于语言理解能力弱。每种语言在其自身语境下表现良好，并与其他语言在候选文档排序上保持一致；分歧仅在语言共享索引时出现。我们追溯其机制：每种语言维持自身的排名，但在共享索引中，其正确答案被推至极低位置，埋没于查询语言或英语的非相关文档之下。为此，我们提出分歧引导式引导策略：针对每种语言，对比其他语言对问题达成一致的文档与其自身特异性检索结果，取两者表征之差作为该语言特有的方向向量，在推理时添加到该语言的查询中。相较于语言均值移除、子空间移除和每语言旋转等基线方法，该方法最有效减少同语言拥挤现象，同时在召回率上保持竞争力，尽管在排名质量上略逊于均值移除方法。

The Geometry of Language Model Logits: Generic Structure and Learned Departures
语言模型logits的几何结构：通用模式与学习到的偏离
Autoregressive language models produce, at every prediction step, a vocabulary-sized logit vector whose structure determines the conditional next-token distribution. We empirically identify that the ordered vocabulary-head logits follow a remarkably consistent log-linear relation \[ z_{(r)} \approx μ- α\log r. \] across prediction contexts, architectures, and scales, emerging progressively during pretraining. To our knowledge, this is the first systematic analysis of the logit geometry underlying the distributional assumptions used in the prior decoding work. While controlled order-statistic baselines spanning bounded, light-tailed, and heavier-tailed distributions can largely explain the observed log-linear geometry, they do not explain the systematic shift in the slope $α$: trained language models exhibit $α\approx 1.4$--$1.7$, sitting well above the initialization baseline ($α\approx 0.2$) . Moreover, $α$ correlates with predictive performance, suggesting that it captures learned structure beyond generic extreme-value effects.

Imprinting: Knowledge Distillation Can Shift Student Behavior
印记：知识蒸馏可改变学生行为
Knowledge distillation trains student models on teacher-generated responses to transfer task capability, but those responses may also carry behavioral tendencies of their source. We investigate whether the source teacher can shape student behavior beyond the capability that distillation is intended to transfer. We construct harm-accepting and harm-avoiding variants of the same base teacher, use them to generate responses to ordinary reasoning and knowledge questions unrelated to safety, and distill those responses into students with different base models. Students generally acquire task capability while their downstream decisions shift toward the source teacher's safety-pragmatism disposition, a phenomenon we call imprinting. Distillation from the harm-accepting teacher reduces harm avoidance, whereas distillation from the harm-avoiding teacher increases it. Imprinting varies across teacher-student pairs and does not extend uniformly across different forms of safety behavior. Excluding a sparse set of divergence tokens reduces imprinting, whereas response rewriting preserves the source-dependent effect and can introduce additional rewriter-dependent shifts. Post-distillation preference optimization raises harm avoidance but does not eliminate the source-dependent difference. These results show that behavioral tendencies can be intentionally imprinted through the source teacher, even with ordinary task supervision.

Copying Is Not Grounding: Training Faithful Long-Form RAG with Authored-Sentence Credit

In search engines and assistants, long-form RAG answers can mislead readers with claims their sources do not support. Faithfulness rewards, the share of supported sentences, train models toward fewer such claims. We show that these rewards are hacked by copying. A sentence copied from the passages is supported almost by construction, so trained models learn to copy rather than ground what they write. Common defenses only move the hack: a KL or copy penalty leaves copying in place or trades it for shorter, emptier answers and refusals. GRPO, the standard RL algorithm, makes it worse by giving every sentence its answer's advantage, reinforcing copied and grounded sentences alike. We propose Authored-Sentence Credit (ASC) , which fixes both by moving GRPO's reward and advantage from the answer to the sentence level. The reward credits only sentences that are authored rather than copied, say more than the question, and are supported by the passages. The advantage compares each sentence with every sentence sampled for the question, so one that earns no credit ranks last and is never reinforced. Across four models and two in-domain, three held-out corpora, only ASC lowers the error rate of authored sentences and writes more supported ones in every setting, by 38% and 46% at the median under held-out evaluators, giving readers more grounded information. It takes none of these shortcuts, and two LLM judges comparing whole answers prefer no baseline to the base model but rate ASC's answers on par with it. We conclude that a faithfulness reward should credit what a model writes, not what it copies.
中文翻译
在搜索引擎和助手系统中，长篇RAG回答可能因引用来源不支持的主张而误导读者。忠实性奖励（即支持句的比例）旨在训练模型减少此类主张。我们发现这些奖励容易被复制行为所利用：从段落中复制的句子几乎必然被支持，因此训练后的模型学会复制而非真正扎根于内容。常见的防御措施仅转移了漏洞：KL惩罚或复制惩罚要么保留复制行为，要么以更短、更空洞的回答和拒绝为代价进行替换。标准强化学习算法GRPO使情况更糟，因为它将整个答案的优势分配给每个句子，从而同时强化了复制和扎根的句子。我们提出作者句信用（ASC），通过将GRPO的奖励和优势从答案层级转移到句子层级来解决这两个问题。奖励仅授予那些由模型原创而非复制、超出问题本身且有段落支持的句子。优势则将每个句子与其他采样句子进行比较，未获信用的句子排名最低，永远不会被强化。在四个模型和两个域内、三个独立数据集上的实验表明，只有ASC降低了原创句子的错误率，并在所有设置中写出更多受支持的句子，平均提升38%和46%（在独立评估者下）。ASC不采用任何捷径，两名LLM裁判在整体答案比较中认为无基线优于基础模型，但对ASC生成的答案评价与基础模型相当。结论是，忠实性奖励应奖励模型所写的内容，而非其所复制的内容。

Reliable Memory from Unstable Growth: Curating Self-Written Agent Playbooks with Randomized Experiments
从不稳定增长中获得可靠记忆：通过随机实验整理自写智能体手册
Persistent textual memory lets language-model agents reuse lessons from past tasks to improve on future multi-step tasks without retraining. Systems such as ACE and Dynamic Cheatsheet keep it as a playbook: lessons the agent writes after each task and reads in its prompt. A key challenge is to decide which lessons improve later tasks. Current systems leave the decision to the agent itself, which makes performance unstable: the same procedure can write a playbook that helps or one that falls up to 69.6 points below no playbook. These findings motivate valuing lessons by their measured effect on task success rather than by the agent's judgment. We propose Randomized Block Curation (RBC), which measures this effect with a randomized experiment on practice tasks. It groups related lessons into blocks large enough to move success measurably and, on each practice task, includes or leaves out every block at random. Random inclusion makes tasks with and without a block comparable, so the gap in their success estimates the block's effect. RBC keeps the blocks that help and, since the same procedure can write a helpful or a harmful playbook, grows several and serves whichever curated, whole or no playbook scores best on fresh practice episodes. Across two memory systems, three models and three benchmarks, RBC raises average success to 66.9, against 55.5 with the whole playbook, 54.1 with no playbook and 53.8 when the agent's own judgment picks the lessons to keep.
中文翻译
持久的文本记忆使语言模型代理能够复用过去任务的经验来改进未来的多步任务，而无需重新训练。如ACE和Dynamic Cheatsheet等系统将其保存为手册：代理在每次任务后自行撰写的经验教训，并在后续提示中读取。一个关键挑战是如何决定哪些经验有助于后续任务。当前系统将决策权交给代理自身，导致性能不稳定：相同流程可能写出帮助性手册，也可能导致成绩比不使用手册低达69.6分。这些发现促使我们依据经验对任务成功率的实际影响来评估其价值，而非依赖代理自身的判断。我们提出随机块整理（RBC），通过在练习任务上进行随机实验来测量这种影响。它将相关经验分组为足够大的块，以便能显著影响成功率，并在每个练习任务中随机包含或排除每个块。随机包含使得有块与无块的任务可比，两者成功率的差距即为该块的影响。RBC保留有益的块，由于同一流程可能写出有益或有害的手册，因此生成多个手册，并在新的练习任务中选择表现最佳的完整手册或不使用手册。在两个记忆系统、三个模型和三个基准测试中，RBC将平均成功率提升至66.9，相较完整手册的55.5、无手册的54.1以及代理自身判断选择的53.8均有显著提升。

Linear probes on a model's hidden states are used as cheap monitors for indirect prompt injection: they screen the tool outputs an agent reads and send suspicious ones to a slower second check, so every false alarm has a cost. But a probe learns whatever separates its training examples. The standard evaluation of injection probes can be passed without the model: conversation position and text lengths alone reach 0.91-0.98 AUROC. When each attack is compared with the same conversation without the injection, or with harmless text formatted like an injection, standard probes flag most of these harmless cases. We add such cases to the training data as matched negatives. Across six open models, in applications seen during training and at the default threshold, changing only the training data cuts false alarms on injection-free conversations from 41-80% to 4-27%, and on harmless look-alikes from 92-98% to 3-16%. With a threshold set on normal traffic, our probe still catches a median 95% of the attacks that fooled the agent (91% without our data). In new applications, false alarms stay low, but detection depends on the model and on how the threshold is set. The same data also helps a text-only filter.
