[2610.15843]
Binding Phoneme Identity to Position in Neural Models and the Human Brain
将音素身份绑定到神经模型和人类大脑中的位置
A fundamental challenge in cognitive science and neural computation is the binding problem. Compositional generalization can be achieved by factorizing representations into roles, the structural slots of a representation (e.g., serial position or syntactic function), and fillers, the contents occupying them (e.g., a phoneme or a word), which can be recombined freely to represent novel combinations. How neural systems implement role--filler binding, however, remains unknown. One of its simplest cases is phoneme sequencing, where phoneme identity (filler) must be bound to position (role) so that /gum/ and /mug/ are represented differently. A proposal from NLP, the `onion hypothesis' (Csordas et al., 2024), holds that the direction of the neural population state encodes token identity, while its magnitude encodes position. It was formulated for random token sequences; we extend it to natural language and test it in neural models and the human brain. We first evaluated it in an encoder-decoder trained to repeat English words, using representational geometry analyses and causal interventions. Magnitude alone proves incomplete: position is encoded by magnitude together with a systematic rotation of the state direction, a scheme we formalize as the `spiral hypothesis'. We then analyzed intracranial recordings from the auditory cortex of 20 participants listening to short sentences. Across superior temporal gyrus electrodes, the change in population response between consecutive phonemes decreases in magnitude as position advances, and its direction is aligned within consonants and within vowels but near orthogonal across the two classes, supporting the magnitude coding shared by both accounts. These results provide a geometric account of how neural systems bind phoneme identity to position, and show how neural-model hypotheses can yield testable predictions about human neural computation.
中文翻译
认知科学和神经计算中的一个基本挑战是绑定问题。通过将表示分解为角色（如序列位置或句法功能）和填充物（如音素或单词），可以实现组合泛化，这些元素可自由重组以表示新组合。然而，神经系统如何实现角色-填充物绑定仍不清楚。其中最简单的情况是音素序列，音素身份（填充物）必须与位置（角色）绑定，以区分/gum/和/mug/。NLP领域提出的一种假设——“洋葱假说”（Csordas等，2024）认为，神经种群状态的方向编码标记身份，而其幅度编码位置。该假说最初针对随机标记序列提出；我们将其扩展至自然语言，并在神经模型和人类大脑中进行测试。首先，在一个训练用于重复英语单词的编码器-解码器模型中评估该假说，使用表示几何分析和因果干预。结果表明，仅靠幅度无法完整编码位置：位置由幅度与状态方向的系统性旋转共同编码，我们将其形式化为“螺旋假说”。随后，分析了20名参与者听短句时的颅内听觉皮层记录。在上颞回电极上，连续音素之间种群响应的变化幅度随位置推进而减小，且方向在辅音内和元音内对齐，但在两类之间接近正交，支持两种假说共有的幅度编码。这些结果提供了神经系统如何将音素身份绑定到位置的几何解释，并展示了神经模型假设如何产生关于人类神经计算的可检验预测。

[2610.15836]
Latent Taxonomies: How Property Induction Develops in Language Model Pre-training
潜在分类体系：属性归纳在语言模型预训练中的发展
When told that robins have sesamoid bones, people are far more prone to extend the property to sparrows than to whales. This behavior, called category-based property induction, is well documented in humans, but whether and how it develops in language models trained only to predict the next token is unclear. To shed light on this, we construct a hierarchical taxonomy of synthetic entities grouped by the properties they share. We then inject facts from this latent taxonomy into the continued pre-training of Pythia and OLMo 2 models from 70M to 7B parameters, and track the development of inductive behaviors. We find that taxonomically aligned induction emerges from next-token prediction alone: a property learned for one entity transfers more strongly within its taxonomic category than across categories. Internally, entities that share a deeper category become more similar in activation space, and clustering recovers the full taxonomic tree from entity representations. Contrary to the usual expectation that scale helps, we find that induction weakens with model size when the data budget is fixed, suggesting that larger models memorize individual facts rather than compress them into shared structure. Induction also strengthens with more pre-training before the taxonomy injection, transfers to novel in-context properties, and can be overridden by a latent taxonomy implied by the prompt. Together, these results show that a model's inductive generalization reflects the latent organization of its training data, with implications for data curation and for predicting how far a learned fact will spread.
中文翻译
当被告知知更鸟有籽骨时，人们更倾向于将这一属性推广到麻雀而非鲸鱼。这种行为称为基于类别的属性归纳，在人类中已有充分记录，但语言模型仅通过预测下一个标记进行训练时是否以及如何发展此类能力尚不明确。为揭示此问题，我们构建了一个由共享属性分组的合成实体的层次分类体系。然后将该潜在分类体系中的事实注入Pythia和OLMo 2模型从70M到7B参数的持续预训练中，并追踪归纳行为的发展。我们发现，仅通过下一个标记预测即可产生分类一致的归纳：在一个实体上学习的属性在其所属分类类别内比跨类别传递更强。内部来看，共享更深层分类的实体在激活空间中变得更为相似，聚类能够从实体表示中恢复完整的分类树。与通常预期不同，在数据预算固定的情况下，模型规模越大，归纳能力反而减弱，表明大模型更倾向于记忆个别事实而非将其压缩为共享结构。归纳能力随着预训练时间延长而增强，可转移到新颖的上下文属性，并能被提示中隐含的潜在分类体系所覆盖。这些结果表明，模型的归纳泛化反映了其训练数据的潜在组织结构，对数据整理及预测学习事实传播范围具有重要意义。

[2610.15795]
An Explainable System for Offensive Content Detection in Nastaliq Urdu: Corpus Curation, Transformer Benchmarking, and Word-Level Attribution
一种面向纳斯塔利克乌尔都语攻击性内容检测的可解释系统：语料库构建、Transformer基准测试与词级归因
Automated moderation systems are deployed at scale, yet they remain opaque to the users and moderators affected by their decisions, and their coverage is almost entirely confined to English. For Urdu written in the Nastaliq script, no such system exists, and the annotated resources it would be built on are drawn largely from Twitter/X, where character limits constrain how users write. Interpretability has received little attention, leaving it unclear what such models actually learn. This study addresses these gaps in three steps. First, we curate and publicly release a corpus of 7604 Nastaliq Urdu Facebook comments, extending an earlier corpus by correcting text-level inconsistencies and re-examining the original labels. Second, we fine-tune four Urdu-capable transformers under a common grid-search protocol and compare them against twelve feature-classifier baselines on identical data partitions. The best configuration, Multilingual Representations for Indian Languages (MuRIL), reaches 87.05% accuracy and 87.06% macro F1, improving on the strongest baseline by 5.52 percentage points, a margin that exceeds the 95% confidence interval on test accuracy; the two leading transformers differ by less than the test set can resolve, and performance is stable across five optimizers. Third, we compute word-level SHAP attributions adapted to right-to-left rendering. Attribution mass concentrates on high-frequency slurs but extends to syntactically neutral function words and to political vocabulary characteristic of the source pages, indicating that aggregate performance may rest partly on lexical and topical regularities rather than a generalizable representation of offensiveness.
中文翻译
自动化内容审核系统已大规模部署，但其决策对受影响用户和审核人员而言仍不透明，且覆盖范围几乎完全局限于英语。对于用纳斯塔利克书写系统的乌尔都语，尚无此类系统存在，其标注资源主要来自Twitter/X，受字符限制影响，用户表达方式受限。可解释性研究关注甚少，导致不清楚这些模型实际学到了什么。本研究通过三个步骤填补这些空白。首先，我们构建并公开发布了一个包含7604条纳斯塔利克乌尔都语Facebook评论的语料库，通过修正文本层面不一致性和重新审查原始标签，扩展了早期语料库。其次，我们在统一网格搜索协议下微调四种具备乌尔都语能力的Transformer模型，并在相同数据划分上与十二个特征分类基线进行比较。最佳配置——印度语言多语言表示（MuRIL）达到87.05%准确率和87.06%宏F1值，优于最强基线5.52个百分点，该差异超过测试准确率95%置信区间；两个领先Transformer模型之间的差异小于测试集可分辨程度，性能在五种优化器下保持稳定。第三，我们计算了适配从右到左排版的词级SHAP归因。归因质量集中在高频侮辱性词汇，但也延伸至语法中性的功能词和源页面特有的政治词汇，表明整体性能可能部分依赖于词汇和主题规律，而非对攻击性的通用表征。

[2610.15761]
Robust Marathi Sentiment Analysis using Domain-Adaptive Pre-training and Data Augmentation Approaches
基于领域自适应预训练与数据增强方法的鲁棒马拉地语情感分析
For languages with limited resources, Sentiment Analysis remains a challenging problem due to limited annotated data and strong domain variability across textual sources. Marathi, despite being widely spoken, lacks extensive multi-domain sentiment analysis studies. Recent efforts by L3Cube have introduced multi-domain datasets in Marathi, enabling a better study of domain-aware sentiment classification. This study uses the pretrained MahaBERT model to improve sentiment classification for Marathi across different domains. Models are trained on individual domain datasets and domain-adaptive pretraining is applied using masked language modeling to help the model better understand domain-specific language. In addition, back-translation is used as a method of data augmentation to increase the diversity of training data. Results show that these methods lead to consistent improvements in accuracy across all domains. The improvements range from a minimum of about 0.12% to a maximum of about 1.74%, depending on the dataset. These results demonstrate that domain-adaptive pretraining and data augmentation are effective strategies for improving sentiment analysis models. This helps achieve more robust performance across different domains and makes the approach more suitable for low-resource languages like Marathi.
中文翻译
对于资源有限的语言，情感分析仍是一个挑战，原因在于标注数据有限以及文本来源间存在强烈的领域差异。尽管马拉地语使用广泛，但缺乏广泛的多领域情感分析研究。L3Cube最近的工作引入了马拉地语的多领域数据集，促进了领域感知情感分类的研究。本研究使用预训练的MahaBERT模型，提升马拉地语在不同领域的分类表现。模型在各领域数据集上单独训练，并通过掩码语言建模应用领域自适应预训练，帮助模型更好地理解领域特定语言。此外，采用反向翻译作为数据增强方法，以增加训练数据多样性。结果显示，这些方法在所有领域均带来一致的准确率提升，提升幅度从最低约0.12%到最高约1.74%不等，具体取决于数据集。这些结果表明，领域自适应预训练和数据增强是提升情感分析模型的有效策略，有助于在不同领域实现更稳健的性能，使该方法更适合马拉地语等低资源语言。
👤 Tanvi Somani, Aryan Babare, Samyak Bora, Raviraj Joshi, Abhinay Dhamankar 📅 2026-10-11 🔗 arXiv
[2610.15757]
Enhancing Zero-Shot Domain Transfer in Low-Resource Sentiment Analysis: A Case Study in Marathi
增强低资源情感分析中的零样本领域迁移：马拉地语案例研究
Sentiment analysis is a key task in Natural Language Processing that determines the polarity of opinions in text. For low-resource languages like Marathi--where limited data prevents the direct use of standard statistical methods--models are often trained on single-domain datasets. While this yields strong in-domain performance, it leads to poor generalization to unseen domains. Recent studies highlight the need for domain-robust systems that can handle diverse real-world content through multi-domain modeling. This study investigates how multi-domain training improves sentiment classification for unseen Marathi domains. Models are trained using single-domain, two-domain, and three-domain dataset combinations. Results show that two-domain training improves accuracy on unseen domains by about 8\% compared to single-domain training. Adding a third domain provides further improvement, though the gain is smaller, averaging around 2\% for some domains. These results suggest that training with data from multiple domains helps build more robust sentiment analysis models for low-resource languages, though the benefits reduce as more domains are added.
中文翻译
情感分析是自然语言处理中的关键任务，用于判断文本中观点的极性。对于马拉地语等低资源语言而言，由于数据有限，无法直接使用标准统计方法，模型通常在单一领域数据集上进行训练。尽管这能带来良好的领域内性能，但会导致对未见领域的泛化能力较差。近期研究强调需要具备领域鲁棒性的系统，通过多领域建模来应对多样化的现实内容。本研究探讨了多领域训练如何提升未见马拉地语领域的情感分类效果。模型使用单领域、双领域和三领域数据集组合进行训练。结果表明，与单领域训练相比，双领域训练使未见领域的准确率提高了约8%。增加第三个领域可进一步提升性能，但增益较小，部分领域平均仅提升约2%。这些结果表明，使用多个领域的数据进行训练有助于构建更稳健的情感分析模型，适用于低资源语言，但随着领域数量增加，收益逐渐递减。

[2610.15712]
TL;QR: Querying Temporal Discursive Patterns in Textual Corpora
TL;QR：查询文本语料库中的时间性话语模式
Many questions about large textual corpora concern patterns that unfold over time, such as a political group whose stance on a topic drifts from support to criticism over several years of debates. We present TL;QR (Too Long; Query with logical temporal Reasoning), a declarative query language and open-source engine for finding such temporal discursive patterns. In TL;QR, a single query combines natural-language predicates, whose truth is judged by a Large Language Model (LLM), with regular expressions and the operators of a temporal logic. The LLM answers only local questions about individual text passages; a symbolic engine then aggregates these judgments over time and links every match to the recorded passages and predicate decisions behind it. With this division of labor, the temporal and relational reasoning stays exact and auditable even over long time horizons. In addition, when a query includes a regular-expression pre-filter, only a small fraction of the corpus ever reaches the LLM. On a suite of controlled synthetic benchmarks with temporally and semantically complex patterns, TL;QR is substantially more accurate than LLM-only baselines. In a case study on ten years of European Parliament debates (442,593 multilingual speeches), TL;QR identifies candidate shifts in the political groups' stances on the GDPR privacy regulation.
中文翻译
许多关于大规模文本语料库的问题涉及随时间演变的模式，例如某个政治团体在数年辩论中对某一议题的态度从支持转变为批评。我们提出TL;QR（太长；用逻辑时间推理查询），一种声明式查询语言及开源引擎，用于发现此类时间性话语模式。在TL;QR中，单个查询结合了由大语言模型（LLM）判断真伪的自然语言谓词，以及正则表达式和时间逻辑运算符。LLM仅回答关于单个文本片段的局部问题；符号引擎随后在时间维度上聚合这些判断，并将每个匹配结果与对应的文本片段及其谓词决策记录关联起来。这种分工使得即使在长时间跨度下，时间与关系推理依然精确且可审计。此外，当查询包含正则表达式预过滤器时，仅有极小部分语料库会进入LLM处理。在一系列具有复杂时间与语义结构的合成基准测试中，TL;QR显著优于仅依赖LLM的基线方法。在欧洲议会十年辩论（442,593篇多语言演讲）的案例研究中，TL;QR成功识别出各政治团体在GDPR隐私法规立场上的潜在转变。

[2610.15705]
bharatSetu: a 1M x 22 bridge for indic translation
bharatSetu：一个100万×22的印地语翻译桥梁
India's Eighth Schedule recognises 22 languages, yet parallel data is uneven across them, and many language pairs, especially among lower-resource languages such as Bodo, Dogri, Santali and Kashmiri, lack direct bitext. We present BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M, a row-aligned table of 984,764 English sentences, each paired with machine translations into all 22 scheduled languages (21,664,808 Indic cells), generated with the sarvamai/sarvam-translate model family. Because every Indic cell in a row translates the same English sentence, any two columns form a translation pair: 462 directed Indic-to-Indic pairs, or 506 including English, without direct bitext. We call these pivot-derived pairs and propose a confidence layer that lets users choose how strictly each pair is connected. The corpus is machine-generated and not human-verified; quality is expected to vary by language, domain and sentence style, and pivot-derived pairs can inherit errors from both sides. We therefore release BharatSetu as a machine layer and propose a human-correction layer keyed to the same row identifiers, so that each corrected column upgrades every pair that uses it, together with an evaluation protocol. We report no translation-quality results.
中文翻译
印度第八次宪法修正案承认22种语言，但这些语言之间的平行语料分布不均，尤其是博多语、多格里语、桑塔利语和克什米尔语等低资源语言，缺乏直接的双语对照文本。我们提出BharatSetu 22-Indic 1M，一个包含984,764个英文句子的行对齐表格，每句对应所有22种官方语言的机器翻译（共21,664,808个印地语单元格），由sarvamai/sarvam-translate模型族生成。由于同一行中所有印地语单元格翻译的是同一英文句子，任意两列均可构成翻译对：共462个定向印地语到印地语翻译对，或包括英文在内的506个翻译对，无需直接双语语料。我们称其为“枢纽衍生对”，并提出一个置信度层，让用户灵活设定每对连接的严格程度。该语料库为机器生成，未经人工验证；质量因语言、领域和句子风格而异，枢纽衍生对可能继承双方错误。因此，我们将其作为机器层发布，并提议建立以相同行标识为键的人工校正层，使每一列的修正可升级所有使用该列的翻译对，同时提供评估协议。文中未报告翻译质量结果。

[2610.15678]
The Mathematical Collective Unconscious: Jungian Archetypes within the Latent Space
数学集体无意识：潜在空间中的荣格原型
Carl Jung theorised that the human psyche contains an inherited framework, the collective unconscious, populated by universal archetypes. As large language models (LLMs) are trained on vast corpora of textual data, this paper investigates whether they spontaneously construct distinct archetype-like regions within their high-dimensional latent spaces. The paper proposes that these regions function as spatial constraints that naturally organise semantically related narratives. To evaluate this, we applied cosine similarity and angular distance metrics across thirteen experiments utilising OpenAIs text-embedding-3-small model. The paper contains two experimental sections the first section explores these ideas using synthetically constructed narratives, the results of which act as a baselines for experiments conducted in the second section where the synthetic data is replaced by human-authored literature (Shmoop corpus), unedited dream reports (DreamBank corpus), and culturally distilled folklore (Andrew Langs Fairy Books). The results show that archetypal roles occupy distinct, measurable regions in the latent space. Crucially, these regions remain compact and consistent because of narrative structure rather than simple word overlap. Additionally, text category dictates spatial distribution: dream reports concentrate within Trickster and Shadow regions, while traditional folklore distributes evenly across all tested archetypes. We conclude that transformer latent spaces encode stable regions which appear to correspond to recognised Jungian archetypes.
中文翻译
卡尔·荣格提出，人类心理包含一个由普遍原型构成的继承性框架——集体无意识。由于大型语言模型（LLMs）在海量文本数据上进行训练，本文探究它们是否会在高维潜在空间中自发形成类似原型的区域。本文提出，这些区域作为空间约束，自然组织语义相关的叙事。为验证这一假设，我们使用OpenAI的text-embedding-3-small模型，在十三项实验中应用余弦相似度和角度距离度量。论文包含两个实验部分：第一部分利用合成构建的叙事进行探索，其结果作为第二部分实验的基线；第二部分则用人类创作的文学作品（Shmoop语料库）、未经编辑的梦境报告（DreamBank语料库）以及文化提炼的民间传说（安德鲁·兰童话集）替代合成数据。结果显示，原型角色在潜在空间中占据着明确且可测量的区域。关键的是，这些区域保持紧凑和一致，是由于叙事结构而非简单的词汇重叠。此外，文本类别决定了空间分布：梦境报告集中于“诡计者”和“阴影”区域，而传统民间传说则在所有测试原型间均匀分布。结论表明，Transformer的潜在空间编码了稳定的区域，似乎对应于公认的荣格原型。

[2610.15667]
Rate-Resolved Text Evaluation with Masked Diffusion Language Models
基于掩码扩散语言模型的速率解析文本评估
A single evaluation score can rank generation systems but rarely reveals what failed. We propose rate-resolved text evaluation, which turns the masking rate of masked diffusion language models into a diagnostic axis. By reconstructing text under different fractions of masked tokens, one diffusion score becomes a vector of band-conditioned scores that reflect reconstruction difficulty at varying levels of visible context. On SummEval, preserving this rate structure yields complementary signal: the best masking-rate band improves fusion with autoregressive likelihood over a collapsed diffusion scalar, survives a sample-shuffle control that breaks rate ordering, and adds residual signal to a fixed prompted judge. A second diffusion model reproduces the effect more weakly. On WMT MQM zh-en, roundtrip mask-and-reconstruct probing produces a tunable localization curve in which ranking-oriented AUROC and span-detection F1 peak at different masking rates. Factuality benchmarks bound the interpretation: band semantics are model- and task-dependent, so each application requires empirical validation.

UID therefore lives at the within-scene token level rather than as a per-scene aggregate. Salient scenes also show a moderate and sustained cast of central characters (following an inverted-U pattern), strong third-person usage, syntactically simpler language, and more abstract vocabulary about motivation and conflict. Scale, Drivers, and Limits of Representational Alignment Across Large Language Models

Comparing large language models can reveal shared representational structure and systematic differences between them. However, aggregate similarity measures can obscure how agreement varies across geometric scales and which linguistic properties support it. We introduce two complementary methods to resolve where models agree and what supports that agreement. Standard representational similarity analysis (RSA) summarizes similarity across all stimulus pairs, potentially obscuring differences in alignment between nearby and distant inputs. Neighborhood-Weighted RSA (NW-RSA) addresses this limitation by weighting stimulus pairs according to their proximity in representational space, placing alignment from local neighborhoods to global geometry on a common scale. Counterfactual RSA (CF-RSA) tests which linguistic properties support alignment by comparing intact representations in one model with representations under controlled linguistic perturbations in another. Across diverse language models, we find strong agreement in coarse representational geometry but substantial divergence in local neighborhoods. Alignment is observed both across broadly sampled natural text and within linguistic equivalence classes that preserve particular aspects of meaning or structure. Counterfactual analyses reveal selective sensitivity: changes to logical scope reduce alignment substantially more than the tested changes to hierarchical syntax, event roles, or discourse structure. Alignment also decreases when sentence structure or lexical meaning is disrupted in word lists and jabberwocky sentences, suggesting that the regularities of natural language support stronger convergence. These findings refine claims of representational universality by showing that strong overall similarity need not imply agreement in how models represent finer linguistic distinctions.

Deploying language models (LMs) on the edge presents unique memory, latency, and power challenges absent in high-performance computing. KV-cache compression emerges as a promising approach to address these challenges. However, the effectiveness of current KV-cache compression methods has not been thoroughly examined on edge devices. We also introduce Long-Context Decode Fidelity (LCDF) evaluation, a token-by-token examination of teacher-forced log-losses using the KV-cache under test. Unlike perplexity that gives the same 5.461 score to all methods, LCDF distinguishes different KV-cache compression backends thanks to its paired statistics across seeds and effect sizes. Our companion Raspberry Pi 5 measurement shows all compression backends we tested to be less energy-efficient per token compared to uncompressed FP16 inference. Except for KIVI that is close to lossless in terms of LCDF, our findings indicate KV-cache compression can be improved. LCDF offers a simple and effective way of shedding light on KV-cache compression methods, whose negative impacts have been overlooked by perplexity.

In each setting, only eight LLMs achieve a macro-averaged F1 score significantly above a random baseline, and only one (zero-shot) and two (five-shot) significantly outperform a neural baseline. We investigate the Homogeneity Gap, a semantic phenomenon where a plural definite (e.g., the kids laughed) and its negation (the kids didn't laugh) are both neither true nor false when only some of the kids laughed, whereas their quantified counterparts (all, not all) remain strictly bivalent. We introduce HomogeneityNLI, a diagnostic dataset of 1,000 minimal-pair items crossing determiner, polarity, and group composition across ten logical conditions. Evaluating seven open-weight models, we uncover a pervasive Bivalence Bias: models assign plural definites their homogeneous truth conditions, reading the kids as all of them and the kids didn't as none of them, yet collapse the truth-value gap into falsity. In the zero-shot setting, no model recognizes the gap for both polarities in more than 15% of scenarios, and negated definites are judged False in 84% of cases. Explicit linguistic rules, chain-of-thought, and enumeration prompts produce unstable, model-specific effects that often entrench the bias. Taken together, our findings indicate that current open-weight LLMs have acquired the truth conditions of plural predication but not its trivalent logic.

In protein modeling, a single CoBit checkpoint supports forward folding, inverse folding, and joint sequence-structure generation. For jointly generated proteins spanning 100-500 residues, computational refolding of CoBit's sequences yields structures that agree with the generated backbones at a mean self-consistency TM-score of 0.911. Together, these results show that CoBit provides a common generative framework for substantially different modalities and forms of cross-modal dependence, without introducing a domain-specific objective or sampling procedure.

[2610.14212]
Modeling the Arrival Time of Information-Bearing Events in Natural Language
自然语言中信息承载事件到达时间的建模
Understanding how information is distributed over time is fundamental to modeling natural language. While existing empirical studies primarily rely on post-hoc analysis of information-theoretic metrics, such as surprisal, little is known about the generation processes under the surface. We propose a novel approach for addressing this gap using the tool of neural temporal point processes (TPPs) by modeling the key information-bearing events in text sequences with learnable event intensity functions. Our model takes the history of event intervals and the contextual semantic representations from LLMs as input, and predicts the future arrival times for two types of events: new-word and high-surprisal-token. The experimental results reveal an interesting distinction in event intensities: LLMs tend to produce new words at significantly higher rates than humans, while high-surprisal tokens do not exhibit the difference. A decaying pattern of intensity over time is found in new-word events for both humans and LLMs, but not in high-surprisal-token events. Our findings revisit and extend previous studies that use simpler methods; provide supplementary evidence for theories about constrained context representation inherent in human language production; and find a new angle to view human and LLM generation differences.

Next-Concept Modeling: Fast, Parallel Coarse-to-Fine Text Generation
下一概念建模：快速、并行的粗粒度到细粒度文本生成
Diffusion language models (DLMs) offer parallel sampling for faster generation than autoregressive models, an increasingly important advantage as inference becomes a dominant computational workload. However, DLMs degrade quickly with fewer sampling steps, process the full sequence at every step, and require many passes over the dataset to reach good quality. We introduce Next-Concept Modeling (NCM), a two-stage, coarse-to-fine framework: a multiscale residual VQ-VAE encodes text into a hierarchy of discrete codes, and a transformer generates one level at a time, predicting all codes within a level in parallel. At matched parameter scales, NCM achieves better generative perplexity than the strongest DLM baseline on LM1B while running $21\times$ faster. On OpenWebText, NCM is competitive with the strongest DLM while running $10\times$ faster; on XSum, it matches the strongest DLM's ROUGE-L while being $31\times$ faster. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations. On the reasoning task of Sudoku, NCM outperforms autoregressive and diffusion baselines across all difficulty levels, using fewer function evaluations.
